多智能体系统

[MA-0] opological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在相同智能体数量与通信预算下，因支持不同形式的协同交互而导致系统能力差异的问题。其核心挑战在于区分任务层面的兼容性障碍（compatibility obstructions）与系统实际能力之间的界限。为此，作者提出拓扑不可约性层（Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility, TSI）这一层论（sheaf-theoretic）框架，将任务结构与系统容量分离建模：任务由交互复形（interaction complex）$ K $ 和容量层（capacity sheaf）$ \mathcal{F} $ 表示，非零上同调群 $ H^n(K; \mathcal{F}) $ 构成结构性签名（structural signature），用于刻画任务本身的拓扑约束；而通过注册干预（registered interventions）测试系统对这些约束的实际响应能力。关键在于，对于上链数据而言，上链实现（cochain realization）可解当且仅当其所代表的上同调类为零。该方法揭示了结构性签名具有层相关性（sheaf-relative），且一阶降维可导出循环空间的见证（cycle-space witnesses）与观测需求。实验验证表明，在15,625个一阶输入中，全智能体加法原语可精确求解决策与修复任务；最优成对系统在决策任务上达到88.80%准确率（仅高于88.79%多数类基线一个输入），修复任务为26.63%；在531,441个二阶四面体边界任务中，保持相同2-骨架结构的三智能体原语系统虽保留全部四个三智能体原语，却始终与仅使用成对原语的最优解性能一致，而引入类别填充型四智能体原语后，两类任务均实现精确求解。状态保持型鲁棒性检验维持了精确性能，但未在成本上匹配类别恢复型消融实验。综上，基于注册原语与成本模型，TSI提供了一种任务相关的、可证伪的高阶交互能力评估机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26777
作者: Steven Motta,Davide Mambelli,Alessandro Rozza
机构: distributed cognition
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 31 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex K and a capacity sheaf \mathcalF ; nonzero H^n(K;\mathcalF) defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.

[MA-1] Autonomous intelligence for mining productivity: a multi-agent AI approach to operational value creation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决集成远程操作中心（IROCs）在迈向全自主化过程中面临的两大核心问题：一是缺乏能够协调监督控制与数据采集系统、数字孪生、预测分析及人机交互界面的集成式智能体架构，尤其在安全关键约束下的协同机制缺失；二是现有评估框架无法兼顾实时性、健康-安全-环境（HSE）、合规审计性以及决策成本等工业级智能体部署的关键要求。其解决方案的关键在于提出EI2ROC——一个三层多智能体架构，通过大型语言模型（LLM）作为调度器，结合专用监控与产能预测智能体，并借助类模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）的工具接口实现高效通信。该架构不仅实现了跨系统的协同优化，还配套提出了一个多维度基准测试框架，涵盖场景库、测试工具集、评估指标体系及人因校准协议，系统性地填补了当前工业智能体评估的盲区。论文明确区分了原型系统中已实现组件、参考设计部分及未来工作，并基于实际运行站点提供了初步的成本与延迟观测数据，为资本密集型行业（如采矿、油气、能源）的智能化升级提供了可迁移的方法论蓝图。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26369
作者: N Guerin(CGS i3),A Dehoux(ERAMET),M Nakhla(CGS i3)
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Integrated Remote Operation Centres (IROCs) are emerging as the architectural frontier of Industry 4.0 for capital-intensive sectors such as mining, oil and gas, and energy. Yet two intertwined gaps constrain their evolution towards full autonomy. First, no integrated agentic architecture has been proposed for mining IROCs that orchestrates Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems, digital twins, predictive analytics and human-machine interfaces under safety-critical constraints. Second, no evaluation framework jointly addresses the real-time, Health-Safety-Environment, regulatory-auditability and cost-per-decision requirements that govern industrial agentic deployments. This paper makes four contributions. It synthesises industry needs and quantified gains documented in analogous industries that motivate an agentic approach to mining IROCs. It introduces EI2ROC, a three-tier multi-agent architecture combining a Large Language Model orchestrator with specialised monitoring and production-capacityprediction agents communicating through a Model Context Protocol-style tool interface. It provides a critical review of agentic evaluation along six orthogonal dimensions and identifies the industrial blind spot of current benchmarks. Finally, it proposes a multi-dimensional benchmarking framework for industrial agentic AI comprising scenario library, harness, metrics and humancalibration protocol. The paper states explicitly which components are implemented in the current prototype, which belong to the proposed reference design and which remain future work, and reports preliminary cost and latency observations from an operating site. Together, EI2ROC and the benchmarking framework constitute a methodological blueprint transferable across CAPEX intensive industries.

[MA-2] Discovery-Probability Graph Planning for Embodied Agents in Tasks with Hidden Cooperation Requirements

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在动态环境中，智能体面对隐性协作任务（hidden-cooperation tasks）时的协同能力不足问题。这类任务的特点是协作需求仅在智能体观察并交互于任务相关目标后才显现，与传统假设协作任务预先已知的情况形成对比。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为发现概率图规划（Discovery-Probability Graph Planning, DPGP）的新方法，该方法构建了一个发现概率图（discovery-probability graph），用于编码任务相关目标的数量与位置的概率分布，从而支持智能体间高效的信息共享与协同决策。在此基础上，结合搜索算法生成最小化期望成本的动作规划，显著提升了协作成功率与执行效率。实验表明，DPGP在C-WAH和TDW-MAT基准上分别达到99.3%和58.3%的协作成功率，优于所有基线方法，并有效降低了整体实体执行时间与大语言模型（LLM）的词元（token）消耗。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26359
作者: Zihuang Cai,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Chang Tang,Kenli Li
机构: Hunan University(湖南大学); Geely Holding Group(吉利控股集团)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 25 pages, 6 figures, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Embodied agents are increasingly capable of perceiving, planning, and acting autonomously in dynamic environments, demonstrating strong performance on complex cooperative tasks. Recent advances typically assume that cooperative tasks are known in advance. In real-world applications, however, hidden-cooperation tasks are more common: the need for cooperation only becomes apparent after an agent observes and interacts with task-related targets. In this paper, we first present HiddenCoop, a benchmark for effectively evaluating agent cooperation in hidden-cooperation tasks. We further propose Discovery-Probability Graph Planning (DPGP), a method for enabling effective agent cooperation in such tasks. At the core of DPGP is a discovery-probability graph that encodes the probability distribution over the number and locations of task-related targets, facilitating effective and efficient information exchange among agents. A search algorithm is then used to derive action plans that minimize expected costs. Experiments show that DPGP achieves cooperative-task success rates of 99.3% on C-WAH and 58.3% on TDW-MAT, surpassing all compared baselines, while also reducing overall embodied execution time and substantially lowering LLM token usage. Our code is available at this https URL.

[MA-3] he Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决量化交易中交易纪律（trading discipline）难以持续执行的问题，尤其关注生成式 AI（Generative AI）驱动的交易代理在实际市场环境下的规则遵循能力。研究通过分析2026年2月12日至8月27日期间同一资产池与执行条件下的2,627个已关闭交易，评估四个AI交易代理在真实价格环境中的策略执行与风险控制表现。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个可复现的交易日志测试框架与代理评估工具包，能够有效区分交易结果是源于严格遵守预设规则，还是偶然性收益（luck）。研究发现，尽管部分代理未盈利，但所有代理均高度遵循止损与止盈规则，97.5%的亏损被控制在声明的止损水平内，且持仓数量限制在多数运行中得以严格执行。此外，系统在经历29%的市场回撤后仍保持风险控制有效性，表明其纪律性具备跨市场周期的稳定性。该工具包的核心价值在于为资本分配前提供“纪律准入”检验标准——即在赋予代理自主权或投入资金前，必须先通过规则遵循性的实证验证，而非仅依赖账户层面的收益表现。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26324
作者: Saad Naja,Nasser Odtallah,Jake Van-Praag,Sarah May
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Risk Management (q-fin.RM); Trading and Market Microstructure (q-fin.TR)
备注: 47 pages, 0 figures, 16 numbered tables. Includes a trading-agent evaluation toolkit and checklist

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception’s size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.

[MA-4] Bidirectionality is Necessary in Cellular Machines for Exact-Arrival Multi-Agent Path Finding

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在存在顶点冲突的有向无环图（Directed Acyclic Graph, DAG）上，基于精确出发与到达时间约束的多智能体路径规划（Exact-Arrival Multi-Agent Path Finding, EAMAPF）问题，将其建模为一个分布式输出任务：每个单元格需独立输出自身对有效联合路径掩码的贡献位。核心挑战在于设计一种完全分布式的、仅依赖局部通信的算法架构，避免全局解码器，并确保在任意拓扑结构下对所有可行查询均正确响应。其解决方案的关键在于证明：在无全局标志（k=0）的情况下，任何仅支持单一时间方向（前向或后向）的局部规则系统都无法在所有可行查询上保持正确性——这揭示了时间方向性的“必要性”；而引入有限个全局聚合标志（k≥1）后，错误性被转化为带宽与通信轮次之间的权衡。通过构造特定拓扑（如十二单元、双智能体、深度三的实例）和反例分析，论文进一步证明了该下界在数量级上的紧性：当将多个副本并列构成复合拓扑时，前向型机器至少需要满足 $ J_R + kR \geq p $ 轮通信，其中 $ J_R $ 表示查询信息传递至目标锥区域的程度，而 $ R $ 为通信轮数。该结果通过形式化验证工具 Lean 4 对构件的有限引理及配对不变性矛盾进行了验证，其余部分采用纸面证明。研究未报告基准测试结果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26272
作者: Masashi Aono
机构: Amoeba Energy Co., Ltd.(阿米巴能源有限公司); Keio University(庆应义塾大学)
类目: Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Computational Complexity (cs.CC); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 33 pages. Ancillary files: Lean 4 development for the finite gadget ( this http URL ), exhaustive check scripts with frozen expected outputs, reproduction README and clean-run log. Companion paper: “Stability Certifies Validity: Amoeba-Inspired Rule Systems for SAT and Single-Agent Trajectory Constraints, Machine-Checked in Lean 4”

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On ranked directed acyclic graphs coupled by vertex conflicts we study exact-arrival multi-agent path finding (departure and arrival pinned in place and time) posed as a distributed output task: every cell must emit its own bit of a valid joint path-support mask. The machines are cellular: one automaton per cell, state factored over cells, communication only along a fixed local fabric, synchronous rounds, a query-independent output round, no central decoder, and a per-topology transition code. “Necessary” here means: on an explicit hard topology, over all its feasible queries, no universally correct local-only architecture can renounce either temporal orientation; with global flags, impossibility becomes a bandwidth-round trade-off. The class is not vacuous: a flooding machine solves every instance in as many rounds as the diameter of the local fabric. The bound survives two concessions: we supply every agent’s exact individual cavity, which alone solves the single-agent problem in zero rounds and makes the single-agent direction theorem vacuous; and we allow k one-bit global aggregate flags. On a twelve-cell, two-agent, depth-three topology no forward-only machine with k=0 is correct on two feasible queries, for any number of rounds; the time-reversed topology does the same to backward-only machines. Placing p copies side by side gives, for forward-only machines, J_R+kR\ge p at constant depth, where J_R measures how much of the query reaches the targets’ cones and is 0 here. A backward-only machine solves that family in constant rounds and a flag-streaming one in \lceil p/k\rceil+O(1) , so the bound is tight in order; on the composite family neither orientation can be renounced. The finite lemmas of the gadget and the pair-invariance contradictions are checked in Lean 4; the semantic bridge, the cone lemma and the counting are paper proofs. We report no benchmarks.

[MA-5] A GPU-Resident Pipeline for Multi-Robot 3D Inspection with Limited Perception

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多机器人在水下结构物三维巡检中如何高效规划协同轨迹的问题，核心挑战在于：在有限视场、短程相机约束下，如何为一组机器人（K台）生成联合覆盖目标表面一定比例的6-自由度（6-DOF）运动轨迹，同时最小化线性插值后的完工时间/总成本目标。由于该联合优化问题属于NP-hard问题，其解决方案的关键在于将复杂问题分解为五个可并行处理的核心阶段：候选视角生成、可见性计算、集合覆盖、基于混合整数规划（MIP）与提升型Miller-Tucker-Zemlin子环消除约束的最小最大车辆路径规划，以及带连续时间机器人冲突检测的优先级驱动多智能体路径规划；前后分别辅以网格加载与表面采样预处理，以及轨迹平滑后处理。关键创新包括：端到端的GPU加速集成框架及其内核设计；针对Lien的ε-可见性算法的四核定制化CUDA批处理实现；基于插值目标导出的β感知单车路径上界，结合Desrochers-Laporte系数提升与禁止对剪枝策略；对Zhou和Zeng的GPU并行前沿A*算法的4D时空扩展；并通过14个大规模网格（最多720万面）的实验验证了路由剪枝与并行前沿搜索的有效性，审计了轨迹平滑后的无碰撞性与航点可达性，并量化了端到端解与解析解及线性规划松弛下界之间的差距。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26106
作者: Kryštof Pšenička,Stefan Edelkamp
机构: 未知
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present a complete, GPU-resident pipeline for multi-robot 3D inspection of underwater structures. Given a triangle mesh and a fleet of K robots, each carrying a short-range, limited field-of-view camera, the pipeline computes 6-DOF trajectories that jointly cover a target fraction of the surface while minimizing a linearly interpolated makespan/total-cost objective. The joint problem is NP-hard, so we decompose it into five core stages - candidate viewpoint generation, visibility computation, set cover, min-max vehicle routing solved as a mixed integer program (MIP) with lifted Miller-Tucker-Zemlin subtour elimination, and priority-based multi-agent path finding with continuous-time inter-robot conflict checking - flanked by mesh loading and surface sampling as preprocessing and by trajectory smoothing as postprocessing. Our contributions are: an end-to-end GPU-accelerated integration of the five stages, with its kernel design documented; a GPU batch adaptation of Lien’s \varepsilon -visibility with four custom CUDA kernels; a \beta -aware per-vehicle tour upper bound derived from the interpolated objective, supplementing the Desrochers-Laporte coefficient lift with forbidden-pair cuts; a 4D space-time extension of Zhou and Zeng’s GPU parallel-frontier A*; and an experimental evaluation on 14 meshes (up to 7.2 M faces) that ablates the routing cuts and the parallel-frontier search, audits collision freedom and waypoint attainment \emphafter trajectory smoothing, and measures the end-to-end gap against analytical and LP-relaxation lower bounds. Code and raw results are publicly available.

[MA-6] Behavioral Probes for Information Flow in LLM Swarms NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有大语言模型（LLM）群体优化方法中过度依赖最终任务效用而忽视个体交互过程中信息处理、整合与依赖关系隐含性的问题。其核心解决方案是基于信息流视角，引入行为探针（behavioral probes）以量化分析信息流动模式。关键创新在于重新利用原本用于幻觉分析的外部上下文得分（External Context Score, ECS）和参数化知识得分（Parametric Knowledge Score, PKS），分别衡量节点对外部上下文的依赖程度和对自身参数化知识的依赖程度。实验表明，在受控与真实场景下，ECS随输入相关性增加并能区分多源信息贡献的有效性，而PKS则随有效上下文积累而下降。基于此启发式规律，研究进一步验证了探针引导的节点剪枝可减少冗余通信与令牌消耗，探针引导的推理路径搜索则显著加速收敛。结果表明，行为探针能够使LLM群体内部的信息流动过程可观测，并作为结构优化的有效辅助信号。

Abstract:Most existing approaches to LLM swarm optimization are utility-driven, focusing on final task utility while leaving the processing, integration, and reliance of information within individual interactions largely implicit. To address this, we study LLM swarm interactions from an information-flow-based view and introduce behavioral probes to quantify information flow patterns. Specifically, we repurpose External Context Score (ECS) and Parametric Knowledge Score (PKS)—originally designed for hallucination analysis—to measure a node’s external-context dependence and parametric-knowledge dependence, respectively. Across controlled and realistic swarm settings, we observe consistent patterns: ECS increases with input relevance and distinguishes useful multi-source contributions, while PKS decreases as informative context accumulates. Building on this heuristic interpretation, we demonstrate how these probes can complement utility-driven structure optimization in two controlled applications. Probe-guided node pruning reduces redundant communication and token consumption, and probe-guided reasoning-path search accelerates convergence compared to utility-only baselines. Our empirical results suggest that behavioral probes can make the internal information flow of LLM swarms observable and serve as effective auxiliary signals for structure optimization.

Abstract:Multi-agent systems driven by large language models (LLMs) rely on structured communication topologies to facilitate information exchange and collaborative reasoning. However, effectively scheduling these topologies to dynamically determine who talks to whom and when to communicate remains a fundamental challenge in balancing collective reasoning performance against exponential token overhead. Existing topology scheduling approaches either enforce static communication graphs that cannot adapt to dynamic problem-solving states, or overlook agent role complementarity while failing to explicitly incorporate the synthesized graph structure into team-level decision evaluation. To tackle these limitations, we propose ACTS, a role-aware adaptive communication topology scheduling framework for efficient LLM multi-agent collaboration. Orchestrated within a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm, ACTS introduces a novel dual-attention mechanism. Specifically, a Role-conditioned Relational Attention module dynamically selects variable-cardinality interaction partners based on agent roles and evolving execution states, while a Topological Attention Mixer explicitly embeds the directed communication topology into team value decomposition for precise credit assignment. Comprehensive evaluations across 9 challenging benchmarks covering code generation, multi-step reasoning, general knowledge, and competitive mathematics demonstrate that ACTS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, boosting average accuracy by up to 6.19 percentage points while reducing token consumption by over 15%. Abstract:With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become a dominant component of digital advertising. Most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, which matches ad content with user preferences in a feature space and recommends the most similar candidates. However, since the candidate creatives are pre-produced, this paradigm limits the granularity of personalization and leads to performance disparities across diverse user groups. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent personalized script-driven video advertising system (MAPS). We design four collaborative agents that form a closed-loop pipeline of user profile modeling, script generation, video synthesis, and feedback-driven iterative refinement. To train the Scripter Agent, we develop a reinforcement learning framework equipped with a multi-dimensional reward function, which steers the agent toward producing scripts that simultaneously align with user content preferences and target product information. Extensive offline experiments on representative datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves encouraging performance in generating and integrating personalized creatives. Online A/B experiments in a specific scenario in the Kuaishou advertising system show that MAPS improves CTR by 2.87%, CVR by 2.74%, and ARPU by 9.85% over the generative baseline.

Abstract:The previous version contained Unicode em dashes. Paste this ASCII-only version: Game theory identifies when a strategic action should be accepted, but not how long a live, language-based counterpart will continue to accept it. We entered the GLEE competition in its final week with one protected agent, Milton, and four instrument agents that ran deterministic, per-game randomized trials of policy changes; Milton received changes only through pre-specified gates or registered, rollback-guarded production rules. In negotiation, learned pricing improves adjusted percentile by 0.071 (n=21,168); in bargaining, a continuation model conditioned on the rejected offer did not improve on a recency-weighted incumbent and was retired. In persuasion, a preregistered five-dose experiment (7,391 assigned games, blinded until a fixed stop) shows that recommending every unit raises sales by 0.194 of the maximum (95% CI [0.147, 0.241]) where the receiver’s slack makes obedience rational (52% of the Bayesian benchmark), lowers them where it does not (-0.067), and produces a larger early-to-late purchase decline than honest recommendations (-0.123). A rule fixed before unblinding now routes Milton’s dose per cell. Milton stood 11th of 460 agents in bargaining at the fixed stop; we also report the close, where the final day’s pool shift moved all five agents’ bargaining ratings together while their play was unchanged, and three dispatch defects were found by checking delivered behavior against the design. 【速读】：该论文旨在解决在生成式模型推理成本降低的背景下，物理实验成为发现过程中的瓶颈问题——即如何在有限预算下合理分配资源，在探索新候选物与对已有潜在优质候选物进行重复验证（确认）之间做出最优决策。其核心挑战在于：每次实验结果具有噪声，高值可能源于真实优势或偶然性，导致模型易误判。研究提出Wellocate基准环境，基于生成数据景观及真实的GB1和PhoQ蛋白数据集构建，通过打乱数据防止模型记忆干扰，模拟真实实验流程。测试五种无外部工具、无长期记忆的语言模型作为最小代理，发现它们在决策上存在双向误配：三类模型过度重复验证（over-confirm），耗尽预算于再测；一类则因轻信单次读数而低估确认的重要性（under-confirm）。前者因候选列表枯竭导致探索不足，引入未试候选列表可显著改善表现；后者即便在终轮重测最优候选，也仅能挽回约25%的损失，表明确认行为需贯穿整个实验周期。研究强调，有效策略必须全局性地平衡探索与确认，并公开提供包含冻结数据划分、脚本基线和强化学习环境的Wellocate平台，以评估和训练智能体更优的预算分配策略。

Abstract:As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at this https URL.

Abstract:Most older adults who hear a warning about scams hear it from someone they know: a relative, a neighbour, or a friend who was targeted. Yet research on scam prevention almost always studies one person at a time. We ask whether scam awareness can spread through a community and protect it the way a vaccine does, since a warning protects whoever hears it and can be passed on. To find out, we built Scam Town, a simulated community in which a large language model plays each resident. Scam centres phone the residents, and after a call a resident can warn the people they know. Word of mouth helped, but it did not take off on its own: each warning led to fewer than one more, so a community cannot count on warnings “going viral”. Across 80 simulated towns, everyday talk cut the number of people scammed by roughly a fifth. The largest gains came when an official warning, from a bank, a senior centre, or an agency, reached most of a town and residents then talked about it: in simulation (a combination we did not test live) the two together cut scams by about half. Protection was greatest when warnings reached the people scammers actually call, who here were older residents. Because our residents are language-model stand-ins rather than real people, we treat these findings as predictions to test with people, not as proof. They point to a simple recipe for scam education: give people a clear story they can retell, design campaigns to be passed along, and reach first those most likely to be called.

Abstract:Agent networks require reliable ways for requesting agents to verify where data is located, how it can be accessed, and whether the data received matches what the data owner made available. Checksum mismatches can reflect either altered content or serialization differences that preserve data equivalence under specified rules. Data identification mechanisms for agents, such as DataFacts, describe where data can be accessed and provide checksums for checking received data against published references. We propose a serialization-invariant identification method that assigns the same identifier to data representations equivalent under explicit rules. We use DataFacts as a case study, retaining its existing checksum alongside the proposed identifier. In a controlled agent study, we compare the proposed configuration with ordinary-tool and checksum baselines across equivalent re-encodings, altered content, and unavailable references. The study includes three model tiers from each of two providers. For equivalent re-encodings, the proposed configuration increased expected-outcome rates by 80.4 percentage points over the ordinary-tool baseline and by 70.2 percentage points over the checksum baseline. The proposed configuration also increased evidence-supported rejection of altered content by 3.5 percentage points over the checksum baseline. We contribute a serialization-invariant identification method with explicit equivalence rules, an integration approach illustrated through DataFacts, and an empirical evaluation against ordinary-tool and checksum baselines.

Abstract:Can one sentence manipulate an agent’s belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of- 10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents’ beliefs.

[MA-14] AgentS oV: Virtual Sensing for LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Stream of Variation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型多智能体系统（Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems, LLM-MAS）在执行复杂任务时可靠性难以分析的问题。由于系统故障不仅源于单个智能体的失效，还受信息与错误在系统中传播路径的影响，现有方法多采用事后故障归因，缺乏对异构多智能体架构的通用建模能力，且无法支持对信息影响和可观测性的全面分析。为此，论文提出AgentSoV——一种基于变异流（Stream of Variation, SoV）的虚拟传感框架，其核心在于将多智能体系统的执行过程建模为随机动态系统，通过将异构的执行轨迹映射至诊断阶段、从可观测输出构造虚拟测量，并利用状态空间模型学习跨阶段的变异传播规律。该方法在阶段依赖关系上具有架构感知性，但在分析语言上保持架构无关性，可统一适用于链式结构、编排型及有向无环图（DAG）结构的多智能体系统。无需重新执行系统，AgentSoV支持三项系统级分析：故障归因以定位异常变异的进入点；阶段输入影响度量以量化中间输入对下游结果的作用强度；以及在监控预算约束下优化虚拟传感器部署以获取互补观测。实验表明，AgentSoV实现了故障定位、信息影响分析与可观测性评估的统一框架，将智能体执行过程从单纯的文本审视重构为动态系统建模，为多智能体系统结构设计与组件优化提供了深层次洞察。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24845
作者: Congjing Zhang,Siyuan Xu,Yunfei Bai,Ke Ren,Xiaoning Qian,Shuai Huang
机构: University of Washington (华盛顿大学); Texas A&M University (德克萨斯农工大学); Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MASs) solve complex tasks through interacting agents, yet their reliability is difficult to analyze because failures depend on both individual agents and how information and errors propagate across the system. Existing approaches largely treat this as post-hoc failure attribution, but do not provide a common model across heterogeneous MAS architectures or support broader analysis of information influence and observability. We introduce AgentSoV, a virtual-sensing framework that models MAS execution as a stochastic dynamic system through Stream of Variation (SoV). AgentSoV maps heterogeneous trajectories into diagnostic stages, constructs virtual measurements from observable outputs, and learns cross-stage variation propagation with a state-space model. Its representation is architecture-aware in stage dependencies yet architecture-agnostic in analytical language, supporting chain-structured, orchestration-based, and directed acyclic graph (DAG)-structured MASs. Without re-executing the MAS, AgentSoV supports three system-level analyses: failure attribution identifies where abnormal variation enters; stage-input influence quantifies how strongly intermediate inputs affect downstream outcomes; and virtual-sensor placement selects complementary observations under a monitoring budget. Experiments across multiple MAS architectures demonstrate a unified approach to fault localization, information influence, and observability. AgentSoV reframes agentic execution as a dynamic system to model rather than merely text to inspect, providing insights for MAS structure and component design.

[MA-15] Measuring Consensus in AI Agent Networks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在复杂协作任务中因信息分散、观点分歧导致的共识形成机制不明确的问题，尤其关注智能体在网络化环境中如何通过协商达成一致决策。其核心挑战在于缺乏对智能体间观点演化过程及支撑决策信息的系统性评估方法。解决方案的关键在于提出一个基于通信历史演化的评估框架，将共识形成建模为智能体公开立场随时间向共享区域收敛的过程；该框架通过追踪立场轨迹（position trajectories）、群体离散度（group dispersion）以及公开信息表达内容，量化分析智能体间的认知演化与信息交互质量。实验结果表明，共享解释性信息显著提升群体决策准确性，而即使整体答案准确，仍存在持续的个体分歧，揭示了决策准确性与有限分歧共存的现象。此外，通过引入成员变更实验，框架进一步区分了智能体间观点收敛程度与任务最优解逼近程度之间的差异，从而将决策准确性与有限分歧与交流过程中可获取的信息量关联起来，为评估生成式智能体系统的协作能力提供了可量化的分析工具。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24833
作者: Jin Gao
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 4 pages. Accepted at the NANDA Workshop, IEEE TPS-ISA 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As AI agents become increasingly connected through networks and take on tasks that require negotiation and joint decision-making, a systematic approach is needed to assess how their views converge and what information supports their decisions. We present an evaluation framework that treats consensus formation as the evolution of publicly stated positions toward a shared region, using accumulated communication history as context. The framework tracks position trajectories, group dispersion, and information expressed in public messages. Two case studies examine staffing decisions based on distributed facts and decisions requiring agents to reconcile duplicate information and a cancelled contract. Results from 1,872 completed runs associate sharing explanations with more accurate group decisions, while the second task reveals persistent disagreement despite accurate aggregate answers. Membership-change experiments provide a complementary evaluation. By separating convergence among agents from progress toward a task’s full-information answer, the framework relates decision accuracy and bounded disagreement to the information available during the exchange.

[MA-16] Cooperation Without Shared Rewards via Reciprocal Q-Augmentation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决非零和博弈（general-sum games）中因个体间存在欺骗或剥削行为而导致的协作困难问题。在社会困境中，即使单一背叛行为也可能使系统陷入次优的纳什均衡，从而损害整体社会福利。传统方法常依赖对其他智能体奖励或内部状态的访问，这在现实中往往不切实际，且隐含引入了额外的合作假设。为此，本文提出互惠式Q值增强（Reciprocal Q-Augmentation, RQA），其核心在于构建一个潜在变量对手模型，用于估计自身行动对其他智能体的影响，并将该估计信息融入自身的Q函数。该方法仅需利用自身Q函数即可学习合作与背叛策略，无需共享奖励或状态信息。实验结果表明，在迭代囚徒困境、旅行者困境、猎鹿博弈及CleanUp-Lite等任务中，所有采用RQA的智能体能更快达成更高水平的合作，且单个RQA智能体可通过适时切换合作与背叛策略，有效引导标准强化学习算法实现合作，显著提升社会福利。RQA的关键创新在于通过内在的反向影响建模实现无需外部协作信号的高效协同。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24793
作者: Francesco Morri,Adel Abusitta,Quentin Cappart,Margarida Carvalho
机构: Polytechnique Montréal(蒙特利尔工程学院); Mila(蒙特利尔人工智能研究所); Université de Montréal(蒙特利尔大学); UCLouvain(鲁汶大学)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:General-sum games are more challenging than fully cooperative or adversarial settings because agents may deceive or exploit one another. Achieving high social welfare requires sustained cooperation, while a single defection can drive agents toward a welfare suboptimal Nash equilibrium. Moreover, assuming access to other agents’ rewards or internal states is often unrealistic and implicitly introduces additional cooperation into the setting. To address this issue, we introduce \textitReciprocal Q-Augmentation (RQA), a method that uses a latent-variable opponent model to augment the Q-function with estimates of how one’s actions affects other agents. RQA allows agents to learn both cooperative and defective policies using only their own Q-function. We show that, in social dilemmas, agents that all follow the cooperative policy of RQA learn to cooperate faster and reach higher levels of cooperation than fully cooperative algorithms. Moreover, a single RQA agent that switches appropriately between its cooperative and defecting policies can induce cooperation in agents trained with standard RL algorithms, which would otherwise end up defecting. We evaluate our approach on the Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma, Iterated Traveler’s Dilemma, Iterated Stag Hunt, and \textttCleanUp-Lite. Our experiments show that the algorithms implementing RQA outperforms fully cooperative methods with shared rewards and enables cooperation with algorithms that otherwise fail to reach high social welfare.

[MA-17] Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在协作过程中因信息冗余导致关键证据被淹没的问题。当多个智能体之间持续交换消息时，重复信息会占据上下文空间，从而稀释稀有但决定性的证据，影响推理准确性。其解决方案的关键在于提出“抑制性消息传递”（inhibitory message passing）机制，该机制受皮层神经回路中抑制作用的启发：通过选择性抑制共享输入，同时保留对弱信号的敏感性。该方法无需训练即可实现，能够在每轮通信中仅向尚未拥有特定证据的接收者转发一次该证据，并排除发送者的推理过程与答案，有效避免冗余传播。实验表明，在三个基准测试中，相较于标准消息传递方式，准确率提升39–77个百分点，单次运行的令牌消耗降低10–46%。该方法在涵盖4亿至320亿参数的七种开源模型及两种商用模型、最多达64个智能体的群体中均表现优异，适用于点对点、编排-工作模式以及多层次层级等多种架构，验证了其在多智能体推理中的可扩展性与高效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24718
作者: Nima H. Siboni,Magdalena Springer,Vahid Rostami
机构: University of Cologne (科隆大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent’s context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents’ messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders’ reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

[MA-18] CARVS: A Congestion-Aware Algorithm for Online Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery in Human-Collaborative Warehouses

【速读】：该论文旨在解决智能仓储系统中人机协作带来的动态不确定性问题，特别是人类行为不可预测性导致的路径阻塞与实时响应挑战。传统多智能体取送货（MAPD）算法在面对人类干扰时表现不佳，难以适应动态环境。为此，论文提出了多智能体取送货与人机协作（MAPDwHC）问题，引入了因机器人与人类交互导致的临时路径阻塞等关键约束，并强调实时响应能力。解决方案的核心是提出CARVS算法，其通过任务交换、有效性验证及随机初始化机制，协同优化任务分配与路径规划，在降低拥堵、提升对人机交互的适应性的同时，保障系统实时性。仿真结果表明，相较于传统MAPD算法，CARVS在大规模场景下显著减少路径规划超时，有效提升了系统的效率与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24549
作者: Chaoran Li,Zeyuan Zhao,Shao Zhang
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (上海人工智能实验室)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Robotics (cs.RO)
备注: 13 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at DAI 2026 (Oral)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Intelligent warehouse systems have transformed logistics by integrating robots with minimal infrastructure changes, boosting efficiency and optimizing workflows compared to traditional human-only operations. However, human-robot collaboration introduces new challenges, particularly due to human uncertainty, which leads to dynamic interactions and unpredictable behavior. To address these complexities, this paper presents the Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery with Human Collaboration (MAPDwHC) problem, an extension of the Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery (MAPD) problem that incorporates human unpredictability. This problem adds key constraints, such as dynamic obstacles caused by robots temporarily blocking paths when interacting with humans, and the need for real-time responsiveness. We formalize the MAPDwHC problem with additional constraints and properties. Based on this problem setting, we propose the CARVS algorithm, which improves task assignment and path planning by integrating task swapping, validation checks, and random initialization. CARVS reduces congestion, enhances adaptability to human-robot interactions, and ensures real-time responsiveness. Simulation results show that CARVS significantly reduces timeouts of path planning in large-scale scenarios where traditional MAPD algorithms fail, improving both efficiency and scalability.

[MA-19] Low-Bit Distributed Constrained Optimization with Application to Optimal Scheduling and Allocation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决分布式约束优化中的通信效率与算法收敛性之间的矛盾问题，特别是在资源分配和调度场景中，如何在保证全局约束满足的前提下，实现极低比特通信开销的高效协同优化。其核心挑战在于：传统分布式优化算法通常需要多比特信息交换（如完整的梯度值），导致通信成本高昂；而现有单比特协议往往难以保证收敛性或最优性。本文提出的关键解决方案是基于拉普拉斯-梯度动力学设计一种仅需每条有向边每轮传输单比特（即本地代价梯度符号）的分布式算法，该方案通过引入非线性映射机制，在保持等式约束始终满足的前提下，实现了任意时刻的可行性。其关键创新点在于：第一，采用李雅普诺夫分析证明了固定步长下迭代序列在 O(1/ε2)O(1/\varepsilon^2)O(1/ε2) 次迭代内进入以最优解为中心、半径为 O(τ)O(\tau)O(τ)（决策变量）和 O(τ2)O(\tau^2)O(τ2)（代价残差）的邻域，且步长上界为仅依赖于图拉普拉斯谱和代价曲率的时不变网络常数，无需自适应调整；第二，放宽了对通信图的假设，首次在仅要求B-连通且权衡平衡的有向图下刻画了系统的不变集，并揭示任意奇数性、保号非线性函数均具有相同的不变集与下降结构，而单比特协议正是这一更广泛非线性类中通信最小化的极端实例；第三，通过光滑惩罚松弛处理局部盒约束，明确量化了惩罚权重与步长上界及最优性间隙之间的关系。仿真结果表明，在经济调度（1000台发电机）和CPU调度（500台服务器）任务中，该单比特协议相较多比特基线可降低5–60倍的总通信成本，仅以可调且显式界定的最优性间隙为代价；实验还发现递减步长策略可消除该间隙，但其严格收敛性分析仍为开放问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24431
作者: Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian,Sergio Pequito
机构: 未知
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: Nonlinear Analysis: Hybrid Systems

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper proposes a distributed resource allocation algorithm in which each agent communicates only the sign of its local cost gradient, a single bit per directed link per iteration. The algorithm is based on Laplacian-gradient dynamics and preserves the equality (demand) constraint at every iterate, guaranteeing anytime feasibility irrespective of termination time. First, we provide a complete Lyapunov-based convergence analysis for the fixed-step-size regime: the iterates are shown to enter, in at most O(1/\varepsilon^2) iterations, a neighborhood of the optimizer whose radius scales as O(\tau) in the decision variable and O(\tau^2) in the cost residual, where \tau is the step-size. Crucially, the step-size bound is a time-invariant network constant (depending only on the graph Laplacian spectrum and the cost curvature bounds), so no adaptive tuning is required. Second, we characterize the invariant set under B-connected, weight-balanced digraphs, strictly weaker than the all-time connectivity and doubly-stochastic weights assumed in most prior work, and show that any odd, sign-preserving nonlinearity yields the same invariant-set and descent structure, with the single-bit protocol being the extreme communication-minimizing instance of a broader nonlinear class. Third, we address local box constraints via smooth penalty relaxation and quantify explicitly how the penalty weight interacts with the step-size bound and the optimality gap. Simulations on economic dispatch (1000 generators) and CPU scheduling (500 servers) demonstrate that the single-bit protocol achieves 5-60 times reduction in total communication cost relative to multi-bit baselines, at the price of a tunable and explicitly bounded optimality gap. A diminishing step-size schedule is shown empirically to eliminate this gap; its formal convergence analysis is identified as an open problem. [MA-20] Adding Heavy-Ball Momentum to Distributed Constrained Optimization for Energy Resource Management Subject to Time-Delays and Quantization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决分布式优化中存在通信延迟、固定对数量化及非连续量化解耦误差时，如何保证系统在迭代过程中维持供需平衡（aggregate supply-demand equality）并实现稳定收敛的问题。其核心挑战在于处理由量化与延迟共同引入的非连续扰动，同时确保优化算法在受限通信条件下仍具备可分析的稳定性与收敛性。解决方案的关键在于采用基于李雅普诺夫-克拉索夫斯基（Lyapunov-Krasovskii）的分析框架，将离散量化误差建模为可叠加的扰动项，并通过构造一个可计算的不变子水平集（invariant-sublevel argument）来证明系统的实用稳定性（practical stability）。该方法在静态连通无向图和有界延迟条件下，实现了关于量化分辨率呈二次关系的遍历残差界（ergodic residual bound），并在无量化情形下恢复对平滑惩罚型等式约束最优解的精确收敛。此外，针对无延迟、无量化且代价函数为二次的情形，通过精确的模态分析（modal analysis）确定了重球（heavy-ball）参数的稳定区域及最优配置，其预测的收敛速率在固定稀疏网络上得到验证。研究还提供可复现的延迟实验，报告了所有常数及一个保证稳态水平低于初始值的证书，进一步增强了结果的可信度。最后，通过混合发电机组-储能系统实验，直接验证了符号化更新（signed update）的实际可行性。值得注意的是，有限光滑惩罚项仅近似满足局部盒约束（box constraints），但通常无法严格强制执行。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24421
作者: Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian,Sergio Pequito
机构: 未知
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Dynamical Systems (math.DS); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: Nonlinear Analysis: Hybrid Systems

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper studies a hybrid discrete-time signed gradient-consensus method with heavy-ball momentum, paired communication delays, and fixed logarithmic quantization. The method preserves the aggregate supply-demand equality at every iteration. For a static connected undirected graph and bounded delays, a Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis establishes practical stability by isolating the discontinuous quantization error as an additive disturbance and closing a computable invariant-sublevel argument. The resulting ergodic residual bound is quadratic in the quantization resolution, and exact convergence to the smooth penalized equality-constrained optimizer is recovered in the unquantized case. For delay-free unquantized quadratic costs, an exact modal analysis identifies the heavy-ball stability region and optimal parameters, with the predicted rate validated on a fixed sparse network. A reproducible delayed experiment reports all constants and a certificate whose guaranteed steady-state level lies below the reported initialization. A separate mixed generator-battery experiment exercises the signed update directly. Finite smooth penalties approximate, but do not generally enforce, the local box constraints exactly.

[MA-21] IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统中，受限于资源条件下如何高效识别最具改进潜力的智能体以实现最大系统级性能提升的问题。现有方法依赖失败归因来判断智能体责任，但其责任程度并不能直接反映改进后所能带来的系统级增益。为此，本文提出一种受影响函数（influence function）启发的方法——IF-MAP，其核心在于通过在低维提示嵌入空间中对受控语义提示扰动下的端到端损失变化进行建模，构建正则化的局部响应模型，并利用估计的响应范数作为优先级评分。该方法为黑盒操作，无需访问模型参数或梯度，可有效生成智能体优先级序列，指导后续的提示优化或模型升级。实验在涵盖代码生成、问答和数学推理的六类多智能体工作流上验证了IF-MAP的有效性：基于其优先级进行提示优化，相较均匀选择平均提升3.81个百分点，而均匀选择仅达1.85；针对五种目标模型的智能体升级，平均提升达7.62–16.42个百分点，显著优于均匀选择的3.81–8.62。此外，相较于全量优化或升级，IF-MAP分别将Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-V3.2的令牌消耗降低74.2%和35.2%，目标模型令牌使用减少63.6%–64.9%，证明其在保持高性能提升的同时大幅降低计算开销。因此，IF-MAP的关键在于通过端到端损失敏感性分析，精准量化各智能体对系统整体表现的影响，从而实现资源最优配置。

Abstract:Improving every agent in an LLM-based multi-agent system can be prohibitively costly, making it important to identify which agent should be prioritized to achieve the greatest system-level gain with limited resources. Failure attribution can inform this decision, but an agent’s responsibility for failures does not directly reveal the system-level gains achievable by improving it. We therefore introduce IF-MAP, an influence-function-inspired method for identifying agents with high potential for system-level improvement. For each agent, IF-MAP measures end-to-end loss changes under controlled semantic prompt perturbations, fits a regularized local response model in a low-dimensional prompt-embedding subspace, and uses the estimated response norm as a priority score. This black-box procedure requires no access to model parameters or gradients and produces agent priorities that can guide subsequent improvement effort. We evaluate IF-MAP across six multi-agent workflows spanning code generation, question answering, and mathematical reasoning, using the same priorities for prompt optimization and model upgrades. Optimizing the selected agents’ prompts achieves a macro-average gain of 3.81 percentage points, compared with 1.85 for uniform agent selection. Across five target models, upgrading the selected agents yields macro-average gains of 7.62-16.42 percentage points, compared with 3.81-8.62 for uniform agent selection. Despite its probing overhead, IF-MAP reduces Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V3.2 token use by 74.2% and 35.2%, respectively, relative to optimizing every agent, and reduces target-model tokens by 63.6-64.9% relative to upgrading every agent. These results support the use of IF-MAP to identify promising agents and direct improvement effort toward greater end-to-end performance gains.

Abstract:Large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive multi-agent environments. Yet most existing benchmarks for LMM-based agents in multi-agent settings remain turn-based: the environment and other agents pause while an agent performs inference. Such protocols obscure a fundamental challenge of real-time constraints, where the world continues to evolve and delayed decisions may become outdated before execution. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce ROAR, a multiplayer action-shooter game environment for evaluating LMM-based agents in multi-agent settings under real-time constraints. ROAR covers cooperative, competitive, mixed cooperative-competitive, and basic single-agent scenarios. We further propose a Multi-Agent Asynchronous Gym interface that decouples environment evolution from agent reasoning by running the environment and each agent in separate threads, enabling the environment to advance at fixed time intervals without waiting for LMM inference and allowing agents to reason independently without blocking one another. ROAR also features convenient deployment, multimodal observations, and customizable levels. ROAR offers a practical testbed for advancing LMM-based agents beyond static, turn-based evaluation toward real-time multi-agent decision-making.

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly incorporated into agent-based models (ABMs) on the premise that richer, context-sensitive human behavior can improve empirical fidelity. However, LLM-supported ABMs introduce an open-ended design space in which subtle modeling and configuration choices, such as prompt design and environment coupling, can substantially alter outcomes. Developing LLM-supported ABMs to simulate human collective behavior therefore requires navigating configuration sensitivity while identifying the limitations of the current model architecture. In this paper, we introduce the \textitModel Capacity Frontier (MCF), a framework that characterizes the empirical performance attainable by a specified architecture across its admissible configurations. In multi-objective settings, this capacity is represented by an estimated Pareto frontier obtained through systematic configuration exploration. We demonstrate MCF in crowd simulation of university commencement events with approximately 12,000 agents, using empirical movement data on temporal occupancy, spatial distribution, and flow direction. We first characterize the capacity of a conventional crowd model and then evaluate successive LLM-supported architectural extensions. In the process, MCF reveals which dimensions of attainable performance expand and which remain limited, providing empirical targets for refinement and re-evaluation. Initial LLM integration improves flow direction but degrades temporal occupancy and spatial distribution; subsequent architectural refinement of the LLM layer improves temporal occupancy and recovers spatial performance, while retaining much of the earlier gain in flow direction. Our case study shows how MCF guides the systematic architectural development of LLM-supported ABMs in configuration-sensitive, open-ended design spaces.

Abstract:Everyday norms of social interaction - e.g. norms of sharing space, taking turns, or queuing - are essential to large societies, offering structured procedures for common interactions. However, it remains unclear how the underlying algorithms of these implicit joint plans evolve as they diffuse through populations. Here we show that this process of diffusion can select against complex algorithms in the earliest stages. We conducted a large-scale study of experimental diffusion of novel social norms among human participants, leveraging advances in program synthesis to characterize the procedures people developed in independent populations. Inherited procedures became structurally simplified and lost during interactions between participants who inherited different variants of joint-action norms; however, opportunities for interactive repair offset this pressure, preserving complex algorithms despite misalignment. These results demonstrate that interactive reasoning mediates selective pressures on structural complexity during cultural evolution of procedural norms.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决团队性能评估中将多阶段生成过程简化为单一评分所导致的表征失真问题，尤其关注在生成式人工智能（Generative AI）系统中，候选答案生成与最终选择之间的分离对整体表现的影响。其核心解决方案在于通过符号回归这一可观测的科学搜索任务，系统比较不同通信架构（如独立、环形、星型、全连接）下固定预算的大型语言模型（LLM）团队，重点分析其生成的候选解档案（frozen candidate archives）与由统一选择规则选出的最优表达式之间的差异。研究发现，将计算预算分配给更多独立轨迹能带来最大性能提升（在最宽泛分配下，平均保留拟合得分Q提高0.70）；而当采用统一的选择规则时，环形（Ring）策略相较独立（Independent）策略使平均Q下降0.33，星型（Star）和全连接（Complete）结构则未呈现明确排序。更重要的是，在固定候选档案的前提下，仅改变最终交付规则即可显著影响架构间的相对表现差距，甚至改变全连接结构点估计值的符号。这表明，架构性能排名并非由通信拓扑本身决定，而是高度依赖于最终选择机制的设计。因此，论文强调应将候选生成与最终选择视为两个独立的评估端点，以避免因选择规则模糊而导致的误导性结论。

Abstract:Team performance is often reported as one delivered score, even though that score is produced in two stages: a system generates candidate answers and a selection rule returns one of them. We use symbolic regression as an observable scientific-search setting and compare fixed-budget LLM teams that differ in peer visibility and update timing, evaluating both their frozen candidate archives and the expressions selected from those archives. Distributing the call budget across more independent trajectories produced the largest measured gain, improving mean held-out fitting score Q by 0.70 at the widest tested allocation. Under a common archive-wide selector, the implemented Ring policy reduced mean Q by 0.33 relative to Independent, while Star and Complete remained unresolved. Holding the generated archives fixed, changing the delivery rule changed the measured architecture gaps, including the sign of the Complete point estimate. These results support reporting candidate generation and final selection as separate endpoints. They do not identify a communication mechanism or a universally preferred topology; rather, they show that an architecture ranking is not identified by communication structure alone when the rule that returns the final answer is left unspecified.

Abstract:How does post-training change cooperation during repeated interaction? Within each of seven released model lineages, we compare pretrained (Base), supervised fine-tuned (SFT), and subsequent preference- or reward-optimized (Aligned) checkpoints across seven social dilemmas. Copies of each checkpoint play one another for 200 rounds, with visible history limited to the last two or forty rounds. The memory curse refers to lower cooperation when agents can see more past rounds. Our central finding is that post-training amplifies this decline. Averaged across the six binary-action games, expanding visible history reduces cooperation at every SFT and Aligned checkpoint. At each post-trained stage, these declines exceed Base’s in six of seven lineages. Most of this average amplification is already present at SFT. With long history, both post-trained stages also cooperate less than Base on average in each binary-action game. In the symmetric binary games, their fitted cooperation rates fall more steeply on average than Base’s as per-round cooperation costs rise, benefits fall, or noncooperation becomes more rewarding. The difference in cooperation rates between Aligned and SFT also changes from one-shot decisions to repeated play. When given the same past records, their choices depend on whether the instructions describe a final round or possible future interaction. Post-training evaluation should therefore go beyond isolated choices to assess whether cooperation is sustained in repeated interaction and how it depends on payoffs and visible history.

Abstract:This paper studies dynamic model routing under uncertainty in multimodal settings, where a system must select and potentially compose multiple models to answer a query. Standard reinforcement learning approaches for routing often suffer from premature convergence to suboptimal models due to noisy rewards and insufficient exploration. We propose a unified vision-language framework (VL-Scout) for efficient multimodal and multi-step reasoning with turn-based reinforcement fusion. First, VL-Scout combines Bayesian priors, policy gradient optimization, and sequential decision-making to enable structured exploration and adaptive inference. A context-dependent Dirichlet belief model allows for epistemic uncertainty over model quality and is updated online based on observed rewards and context-specific evidence, enabling Thompson-style exploration while serving as a prior for regularization. Second, a routing policy is trained via a KL-regularized REINFORCE objective by maximizing a reward-weighted evidence lower bound, where the policy acts as an amortized posterior, and the Dirichlet belief serves as a prior. Third, we introduce a fusion policy trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) or Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which operates over intermediate model rationales and selects between two actions: CONTINUE or ANSWER, terminating with a generated output. We evaluate VL-Scout on four representative multi-modal benchmarks (MMMU, MMMU-Pro, OKVQA, and RealWorldQA), compared against 11 representative routing and policy optimization baselines. Our method provides consistent performance improvements while reducing premature policy collapse. These results highlight the importance of integrating uncertainty-aware priors with both amortized policy learning and sequential fusion for robust and efficient model selection in discrete action spaces

[MA-28] Red-Teaming Multi-Agent Attacks for Loss-of-Control Risks

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）代理在大规模协同部署背景下，因隐蔽合谋（covert collusion）而引发系统性失控风险的问题。随着AI代理能力与持久性的提升，其在分布式环境中执行碎片化攻击任务并隐匿行为特征的能力日益增强，传统基于单个代理轨迹的监控机制难以有效识别此类联合攻击。论文提出一种名为MiniLab的合成测试平台，包含5个相互关联的服务与249个良性任务，模拟真实部署场景，并设计了16种由人类优化的分布式攻击策略（如权重外泄、未受监控的恶意部署、权限提升等）。研究发现，当攻击由多个代理分担执行时，即使每个代理的行为均看似合规，整体攻击仍可成功规避前沿监控系统（如GPT-5.6 Sol）的检测——单独分析各代理轨迹时仅能识别7%的成功攻击，远低于单一代理执行相同任务时的87%识别率。此外，个体攻击可被组合成更长的攻击序列，实现更高阶的失控目标，且无任何单个代理触发警报。实验还表明，尽管当前模型具备一定规划能力，但在面对单轨迹监控时，其自主规划的攻击成功率最高仅为25%，显著低于人类设计的80%。这揭示了现有监测机制在应对复杂协作攻击中的局限性，也凸显了未来需构建具备跨代理行为理解与全局上下文感知能力的防御体系。本工作通过将最坏情况下的协同攻击转化为可复现的红队测试案例，为防范局部无害行为累积导致系统级失控提供了关键评估框架与防御研究基础。

作者: John Kitaoka,Thao Amelia Pham,Carlos Rafael Giudice,Jacob Merizian
机构: MATS Research; Redwood Research
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:AI agents are growing more capable and persistent, and are being deployed in ever larger numbers. As more start collaborating, AI control measures must remain effective when they covertly collude on a harmful objective. We introduce MiniLab, a synthetic series of live services and codebases (5 interconnected services, 249 benign tasks, 8 attack objectives), adapted from internal AI deployment infrastructure. We demonstrate distributed attacks, in which different agents carry out separate attack fragments, and how their covertness evades frontier monitors when reading their trajectories individually. We show how distributed attacks spread across diverse contexts and harmful objectives through 16 human-optimized attacks (weight exfiltration, unmonitored rogue deployment, permission elevation, and more). A frontier monitor, GPT-5.6 Sol, reading each agent separately flags only 7% of successful distributed attacks, compared with 87% when a single agent carries out the same side task. Individual attacks can also be composed into longer attack sequences toward a greater loss-of-control outcome, without any individual agent being flagged. Finally, we tested whether models can plan these covert attacks: even with execution and monitor feedback, the best model-planned attacks succeed covertly against a single-trajectory GPT-5.6 Sol monitor in at most 25% of executions, compared with 80% for human-crafted plans, though this may scale with model capabilities. By turning worst-case coordinated attacks into reproducible red-team cases, our work provides a foundation for preventing locally benign agent actions from accumulating into system-level loss of control.

[MA-29] LLM Evolution in a Simple Simulated Market

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在缺乏明确监管机制时可能因激励机制设计不当而出现系统性退化的问题。其核心关切在于：当模型的优化目标仅聚焦于某一可量化的成本维度（如令牌使用量），而忽略其他关键性能指标（如准确性）时，即便未对模型施加直接指令或反馈，系统仍会通过集体演化过程产生不可预见的负面行为适应。解决方案的关键在于揭示了一种“非显式反馈下的集体优化”机制——在无个体反馈、无记忆、且不理解支付规则的前提下，基于种群演化与突变的市场环境促使代理群体整体向特定行为模式收敛，从而导致原本未被定价的性能维度（如准确性）发生显著退化。研究通过三组对照实验表明，这种适应是由于令牌使用与准确性之间存在隐含的相关性，使得对单一维度的选择压力间接驱动了另一维度的演化，凸显了在复杂系统中设计激励结构时需全面考虑多维属性耦合效应的重要性。

作者: Charlie Pilgrim,Christopher Krupenye,Dora Biro,Richard P. Mann
机构: University of Leeds(利兹大学); Johns Hopkins University(约翰霍普金斯大学); University of Rochester(罗切斯特大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Populations and Evolution (q-bio.PE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Arguments that AI systems will evolve in harmful ways are largely made in the abstract. We provide a concrete empirical example. We simulate simple markets consisting of populations of twenty Large Language Model agents tasked with solving arithmetic problems. Agents differ only in their system prompt; those that go bankrupt are removed and replaced by mutated copies of the prompts of successful agents. Two market conditions select for opposite phenotypes: a market that rewards accuracy produces agents with high accuracy (94%) and high token use; a market that charges per token produces agents with low accuracy (10%) and low token use. In the second market, only tokens are incentivised yet we see a collapse in accuracy. Token use and accuracy are correlated traits such that selection on one also moves the other, and behaviour adapts along an unpriced dimension. A third neutral condition with no selection allows us to separate these effects from bias in the mutation operator. Adaptation occurs through a collective optimisation process that operates above the level of individual agents, who are never told the payment rule, do not receive feedback, and have no memory.

[MA-30] Federation over Harness

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的分布式多智能体推理系统中，依赖人工设计提示词（prompt）和工作流所带来的局限性问题。现有方法在本地智能体提取有效推理轨迹以及全局智能体聚合分布式反思以形成共性模式与洞见的过程中，均需依赖预设的、静态的人工设计机制，难以适应复杂任务动态演化的需求。为此，论文提出Federation over Harness（FoH）框架，其核心创新在于通过自进化机制自动优化本地与全局组件的“引导框架”（harness），实现端到端的自主演进。具体而言，由服务器智能体同时演化客户端的任务求解与自我反思引导框架，并自主优化自身用于聚合分布式反思、维护共享知识库及更新下游客户端框架的全局引导机制。关键优势在于，FoH无需额外验证信号（如真实标签或验证数据），仅依靠分布式智能体生成的自反思内容进行学习。实验结果表明，在多个基准测试上，FoH相比固定引导框架的单智能体基线和仅具备引导框架自演化的方案，分别实现了53.57%和29.76%的性能提升，充分验证了其在无需人工干预下持续优化多智能体协作效能的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24007
作者: Dixi Yao,Tahseen Rabbani,Tian Li
机构: University of Chicago(芝加哥大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern LLM-powered agents increasingly improve through experience sharing, where distributed agents distill local reasoning experience into reusable knowledge, such as a shared insight library. Existing approaches, however, still heavily rely on manually designed prompts and workflows that determine both how local agents extract useful reasoning traces and how a central/global agent aggregates them to obtain common patterns and insights. We propose Federation over Harness (FoH), a framework that automatically evolves the harness for both local and global components in this distributed multi-agent reasoning pipeline. A server agent evolves the client harness for task solving and self-reflection while, at the same time, evolving its own harness for aggregating distributed reflections, maintaining shared knowledge, and updating subsequent client harnesses. Importantly, FoH requires no extra validation signals, such as ground-truth labels or validation data, during evolution; it learns solely from self-generated reflections produced by distributed agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that FoH consistently improves over single-agent baselines with a fixed harness and with harness self-evolution by 53.57% and 29.76%.

[MA-31] win: A Calibrated Digital Twin of Telegram Crisis Discourse as a Ground-Truth Testbed for Detecting LLM -Powered Information Operations

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在真实社交平台（尤其是Telegram）上评估协调性检测算法有效性时缺乏可靠“真实标签”（ground truth）的问题。由于大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）可低成本生成永不重复的影响力传播内容，使得检测此类操纵行为变得极为困难，而现有平台数据又缺乏足够的标注支持。针对这一挑战，研究提出TeleTwin——一个基于LLM构建的Telegram危机话语生态系统的数字孪生体，其中每个频道被建模为一个智能体，其行为依据195个公开频道在2025年3月至8月期间共107万条消息的历史数据进行校准，聚焦于以色列-加沙与伊朗-以色列冲突议题。实验表明，该数字孪生体在模拟6月2025年伊以战争爆发后的每日动态时，其相关性（0.86）显著优于统计基线（0.64），且能无提示地响应重大事件，但存在过度聚焦冲突、夸大转发级联、低估冲击效应以及生成明显具有LLM特征文本等偏差。进一步将已知成员的LLM生成宣传战役注入真实数据与孪生环境后发现：在真实数据中，基于相同文本、共用URL或同步性的检测方法在内容改写、延迟发布或移除链接后即失效；多语言语义相似性检测虽能识别高调战役（包括跨语言传播），但对隐蔽战役无效，且在不同政治立场间误报率分布不均；而在数字孪生环境中，所有检测方法均失败，原因在于模拟背景的语义同质性比真实数据高出约40倍。因此，该研究的核心结论是：数字孪生体虽可提供用于评估传播战役的“真实标签”，但若未充分校准其语义多样性，则无法生成真实可信的背景噪声，从而导致对语义检测器的评估失真。解决方案的关键在于：必须通过引入更丰富的语义多样性来校准数字孪生体，才能使其成为有效评估检测算法性能的可信环境。

作者: Despoina Antonakaki,Sotiris Ioannidis
机构: Institute of Computer Science, FORTH(希腊科技研究所计算机科学学院); Technical University of Crete(克里特技术大学)
类目: ocial and Information Networks (cs.SI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models make it cheap to run influence operations whose messages never repeat, yet real platforms offer almost no ground truth for testing whether coordination detectors can find them. The problem is sharpest on Telegram, which moderates little and spreads content through broadcast channels and forwarding rather than a follow graph. We introduce TeleTwin, an LLM-powered digital twin of a Telegram crisis-discourse ecosystem in which channels are agents, each instantiated from the history of a real channel, calibrated on 1.07 million messages from 195 public channels on the Israel-Gaza and Iran-Israel conflict (March-August 2025). On a held-out period containing the June 2025 Iran-Israel war, the twin tracks daily dynamics better than statistical baselines (correlation 0.86 against 0.64) and reacts to the war unprompted, but it over-focuses on the conflict, over-amplifies forwarding cascades, underestimates the shock and writes recognisably LLM-like text. We then inject LLM-written campaigns with known membership into the real data and into the twin. In real data, identical-text, co-URL and synchrony detectors fail once a campaign rewords, staggers or drops links; multilingual semantic similarity recovers loud campaigns, including cross-lingual ones, but not quiet ones, and its false positives fall unevenly across political perspectives. Inside the twin all detectors fail, because the simulated background is about 40 times more semantically homogeneous than the real one. Digital twins can supply ground truth for campaigns, but not, without calibrating their diversity, a realistic background for evaluating semantic detectors.

[MA-32] LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长视频智能体在处理数小时甚至数天的多模态证据时，如何在有限的上下文长度（token budget）和响应延迟（latency budget）约束下实现高效的记忆管理问题。现有记忆系统主要依赖人工设计的策略，缺乏对性能与效率协同优化的记忆架构设计方法。其核心解决方案是提出一种自动化多智能体框架——长视频元记忆调度系统（Long Video Meta-memory Harness, LVMH），将记忆策略开发建模为围绕固定答案模型的多目标代码搜索任务。LVMH通过分离实现与独立评审机制，并设置受保护的观察边界，有效防止自认证偏差和开发集过拟合。系统持续记录历史提案、推理轨迹、资源消耗及失败案例，形成持久化的元记忆以指导后续策略迭代。在此框架下，研究发现了“自演化证据记忆”（Self-Evolving Evidence Memory, SEEM）策略，该策略采用“文本优先、视觉次之”的范式，从紧凑的结构化事件记忆与证据专家中生成答案，并通过选择性视觉门控仅在必要时调用局部视觉帧。SEEM在EgoLifeQA上训练后可泛化至未见基准，在Ego-R1 Bench与Video-MME (L) 上均优于Meta-Harness，使用GPT-5 mini时平均准确率达65.7%，较此前最优方法提升7.7个百分点，同时平均评估token消耗降低约32倍，平均响应时间缩短91倍，显著提升了长视频理解任务中的性能与效率平衡。
