点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in annotation tasks with varying success. While several studies have demonstrated the opportunities and shortcomings of LLMs for annotation, a critical question remains unanswered: is it possible to predict how well they will perform on a new dataset? To answer this and related questions, we construct two task families which induce 461 text classification datasets. We find that it is possible to predict LLM performance - to a certain degree - and that contrary to other work which highlights the usefulness of LLM verbalizations of self-confidence, internal log-probabilities are the most predictive signal.

[NLP-233] Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决文本到SQL（Text-to-SQL）系统在面对自然语言查询中固有歧义时的局限性，即传统方法假设每个自然语言查询仅对应唯一正确的SQL翻译，而现实中许多查询存在多种合法解释，导致不同语义解读产生差异化的查询结果。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需任务特定训练的多智能体框架——对抗意图解析（Adversarial Intent Resolution, AIR），该框架通过构建竞争性语义解释、利用SQL执行验证其输出差异，并基于观测到的数据差异生成针对性的澄清问题，从而主动识别并化解歧义。AIR在多个基准测试中展现出优异性能、高效率及跨基准的强泛化能力，在仅提供模式信息（schema-only）的现实生产场景下，相比当前最优的强化学习模型IntentRL，表现出更小的性能下降（约7% vs. 约20%），且在涉及模式设计引发歧义的AmbiQT基准上亦实现更高准确率，充分体现了其鲁棒性与通用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24248
作者: Youbing Yin,Xujun Peng,Muhammad S. Uddin,Erin Babinsky,Daben Liu,Anoop Kumar
机构: Capital One(资本一号)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training. AIR first constructs competing interpretations, verifies through SQL execution that they produce genuinely different results, and generates targeted clarification questions grounded in the observed data differences. Evaluating on leading benchmarks for ambiguous questions, AIR demonstrates strong performance, efficiency, and robust cross-benchmark transferability. On the AMBROSIA benchmark under schema-only context, a realistic production setting where exposing the full database is infeasible, AIR outperforms IntentRL, the state-of-the-art reinforcement learning model, across all metrics (e.g., F1 0.679 vs. 0.618). Crucially, AIR exhibits only ~7% performance degradation without the full database, compared to ~20% for IntentRL. On the AmbiQT benchmark, where ambiguity arises from schema design rather than linguistic structure, AIR achieves higher F1 under both context settings without any benchmark-specific adaptation.

[NLP-234] Encoder-Free Multimodal LLM s Learn Implicit Encoders ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）中依赖专用模态编码器（如视觉编码器或音频编码器）所导致的架构复杂性和模态间耦合问题。现有方法通常通过独立的模态特定编码器将图像、音频等原始输入转换为嵌入表示，再与文本输入融合。然而，近年来出现的无编码器（encoder-free）多模态大模型（如Gemma-4 12B和Inkling-Small）采用全新范式：直接将原始采样窗口、像素或频谱特征输入到Transformer语言模型中，跳过显式的模态编码步骤。本文的核心问题是：这些早期层是否在隐式地承担类似专用编码器的功能？其关键解决方案在于揭示——尽管没有显式设计的编码器，但这些模型的早期层仍能自发学习形成“隐式编码器”（implicit encoders），能够以对跨模态上下文不敏感的方式有效表征音频与视觉输入。进一步实验表明，在执行多模态推理任务时，无论是否从第一层起联合编码，仅在早期层中独立处理各模态即可达到相同的性能表现，说明模态解耦在初始阶段并非必要。通过分层探针分析，研究发现隐式编码器所提取的关键信息特征与主流显式编码器具有高度相似性，验证了其功能等效性。这一发现为简化多模态模型架构、提升可解释性提供了实证支持，并暗示了未来无需显式编码器的高效多模态建模路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24239
作者: David Harwath,Desh Raj,Xavier Velez,Sandra Arcos-Holzinger,Willie Jeng,Karen Livescu,Leibny Paola Garcia-Perera,Sanjeev Khudanpur
机构: The University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); NVIDIA(英伟达); Johns Hopkins University(约翰霍普金斯大学); The University of Melbourne(墨尔本大学); Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago(芝加哥丰田技术学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: Submitted to ICLR 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We empirically analyze two recently proposed encoder-free multimodal LLMs, Gemma-4 12B and Inkling-Small. Unlike previous multimodal LLMs, these models do not use modality-specific encoders to extract tokenized embeddings representing audio and image input; instead, they directly feed windows of samples, pixels, or spectral features to the Transformer language model. We analyze whether the early layers of these models learn to function similarly to dedicated audio and visual encoders. We find that these early layers do in fact act as ``implicit encoders,‘’ encoding audio and visual inputs in a way that is largely invariant to their cross-modal context. Furthermore, when performing multimodal reasoning tasks, we show that independently encoding the modalities throughout these early model layers achieves the same accuracy as jointly encoding them from the first layer onwards. Finally, we use layer-wise probing to analyze the salient information captured by the implicit encoders and find their behavior to be similar to several popular encoder models.

[NLP-235] Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能在强化学习中使用可验证奖励（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）时导致的推理行为多样性下降问题。其核心挑战在于：由于有限样本下的策略更新动态，标准的在线策略强化学习会逐步抑制语义上不同但得分相同的推理路径，一旦某类推理模式被过度稀疏采样，便难以通过常规方法恢复。为此，作者提出一种名为目标自适应回放（Targeted Adaptive Replay, TAR）的新框架，其关键在于构建一个紧凑的记忆库以保存基础模型中已有的多样化正确推理解法，并设计一种自适应机制，在RLVR训练过程中仅当这些已有解法出现被压制迹象时才触发选择性重放。该方法有效平衡了推理性能与多样性保持之间的关系，在六个数学推理基准测试及两种Qwen2.5模型规模下均优于现有多样性保持型后训练方法，显著减少了对基础模型正确解法的遗忘。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24236
作者: Wen-Zhi Li,Sainyam Galhotra,Claire Cardie
机构: Cornell University(康奈尔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model solutions. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-236] Analyzing Repetition and Interference Effects in Memory-Constrained User Simulators

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前用户模拟器（user simulator）在评估与训练人工智能系统与人类交互时，缺乏对人类行为真实性的有效衡量问题。其核心挑战在于如何确保用户模拟器在信息记忆方面与人类表现出一致的行为模式。解决方案的关键在于通过检验记忆受限的用户模拟器对两个影响人类信息保留的关键因素——事实重复和竞争性信息干扰——的敏感性，来评估其行为保真度。研究发现，尽管部分模拟器在整体准确率上接近人类水平，并能复现重复与干扰效应的量级，但它们在具体问题上的错误模式与人类存在显著差异：人类倾向于误记（misremember），而模型则表现为彻底遗忘（forget），揭示了现有模拟器在认知机制建模上的根本缺陷。为此，作者公开了该数据集作为未来研究的基准挑战（benchmark challenge），以推动更贴近真实人类记忆行为的用户模拟器发展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24232
作者: Cara Su-Yi Leong,Nicholas Tomlin,Tal Linzen
机构: New York University(纽约大学); Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago(芝加哥丰田技术学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:User simulators can help evaluate and train AI systems to interact with humans at scale. To do so, evaluation of user simulators must measure behavioral parity with people. We evaluate whether memory-constrained user simulators are sensitive to two factors known to affect human information retention: repetition of a fact and interference from competing information. We find that some simulators achieve human-like overall accuracy, and replicate the magnitude of repetition and interference effects, but none match people’s accuracy on particular questions: while humans misremember facts, models forget them, leading to different error patterns. We release this data as a challenge benchmark for future work on user simulators.

[NLP-237] Language Models are Lazy Poets: Creative Mode Collapse at Scale

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式大语言模型（Generative AI）在诗歌创作中普遍存在的“模式坍缩”（mode collapse）问题，即模型输出高度重复、缺乏多样性。尽管已有研究尝试缓解此问题，但针对特定文本体裁（如诗歌）的大规模系统性调查仍十分匮乏。本文通过构建迄今最大规模的生成式诗歌语料库——涵盖15种诗体、248个主题标签及16个开源模型，共生成超过110万首诗歌，首次在百万级数据规模下深入分析了模式坍缩现象。研究发现，尽管模型具备丰富的词汇量与押韵能力，但实际使用中存在严重资源浪费：模型表现出明显的“懒惰”倾向，过度依赖少数高频词、固定句式和重复韵脚，导致语义与形式多样性不足。此外，不同模型与诗体间的词汇同质化程度存在差异，且观察到的押韵词汇丰富度与模型参数规模呈正相关。因此，解决方案的关键在于设计有效的解耦机制与激励策略，以引导模型更充分地利用其潜在的创造性表达能力，打破对有限模式的依赖。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24223
作者: Jacob A. Matthews,Sil Hamilton
机构: Cornell University(康奈尔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While aligned large language models (LLMs) can successfully complete many creative tasks, their outputs tend to be highly self-similar. Though solutions to this problem of “mode collapse” have been proposed, comprehensive large-scale surveys of the phenomenon in specific textual genres are still lacking. We address this gap through an extensive treatment of LLM mode collapse in poetry. Across 15 poetic forms, 248 subject matter tags, and 16 open-weight models, we generate over 1.1 million poems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the largest corpus of LLM-generated poetry to date. At million-poem scale, we find that LLM poetic vocabularies and rhyming abilities are substantial, but severely underutilized. In other words, LLMs are “lazy” poets: despite possessing large poetic inventories, LLMs over-rely on a small number of words, opening phrases, and rhymes. Further, we find that lexical homogenization differs across models and poetic forms, noting observed rhyming vocabulary is correlated with model size.

[NLP-238] Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决复杂推理任务中因上下文窗口（context window）有限而导致的推理记忆不足问题。在处理需要多次重复计算中间步骤的复杂问题时，传统方法依赖模型内部的上下文记忆，但受限于上下文长度，容易丢弃关键信息，进而影响推理性能。其解决方案的关键在于提出RCMEM（Reasoning Context Management with External Memory），通过引入外部记忆机制，在不增加推理模型上下文负担的前提下，持久化存储和管理推理过程中的关键中间状态。该方法有效缓解了上下文溢出问题，显著降低重复计算的开销，同时提升了复杂数学问题上的推理准确率。实验在0.4至2500万参数规模的模型及GPT-2上验证了其有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24187
作者: Man-Ling Sung,William Hartmann,Jiangying Zhou
机构: RTX BBN Technologies; Cambridge MA, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Preprint

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.

[NLP-239] Multi-author style detection with stylistic embeddings EMNLP

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多作者写作风格变化检测中因单一模型在目标领域微调后特征表示能力不足的问题。现有方法仅依赖现成的大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）或在目标域内进行监督微调，难以提取有效风格特征。其解决方案的关键在于引入跨域迁移学习策略，通过针对作者身份验证任务对LLM嵌入模型（如Mistral-7B）进行微调，并结合已知表现优异的DeBERTa模型，在PAN-25多作者写作风格分析挑战赛的基准上进行对比。研究发现，DeBERTa与Mistral在不同类型的用户生成文本场景中各具优势，因此通过融合二者嵌入特征，实现了更鲁棒、更有效的风格变化检测性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24184
作者: Man-Ling Sung,Chak Fai Li,Damianos Karakos,Fred Bernardin,Brian Ulicny
机构: RTX BBN Technologies; Cambridge MA, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted and accepted to Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT) in Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multi-author style change detection. Using off-the-shelf LLMs or supervised fine-tuning solely within the target domain fails to yield effective features; for this reason, we propose cross-domain transfer learning with LLM-based embeddings fine-tuned for authorship verification. We fine-tune Mistral-7B embedding model and compare it with DeBERTa, used in the state-of-the-art (SOTA) systems in PAN-25 multi-author writing style analysis challenge. Results show that DeBERTa and Mistral excel in different user-generated text scenarios. We exploit this diversity by combining both embeddings, leading to more effective style change detection.

[NLP-240] Prosodic Structure as a Critical Component in Phonemic Language Modelling at BabyLM Scale EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前语言模型普遍依赖书面语料（orthographic text）进行训练，而忽视了人类婴幼儿在习得语言初期所依赖的连续性、韵律结构化语音输入（prosodically structured speech）这一生态学上的不一致问题。其核心挑战在于：在小数据条件下（如婴儿早期语言学习阶段），如何有效建模语音层面的语义与句法组织能力。论文提出的关键解决方案是引入韵律标注（prosodically annotated phoneme stream）作为输入信号，构建一个从低到高的音系丰富度梯度（ladder of phonological richness），并在此基础上训练基于BERT MLM架构的音素级语言模型（phonemic language modelling）。实验结果表明，在10M和100M词规模下，仅使用韵律标注的音素流模型在新设计的语义组织任务中表现出最强的分类组织能力，显著优于仅依赖音素或边界结构的模型；同时，通过引入对抗性反向条件测试，发现传统基于伪对数似然（pseudo-log-likelihood）的评估指标可能高估了模型对“词性”（wordhood）的理解，实际反映的是音位构形熟悉度（phonotactic familiarity）。因此，研究证实韵律结构是小数据环境下音素级语言建模的关键成分，有助于提升模型在类婴儿学习情境中的生态有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24172
作者: Bill K. S. Ku,Janet B. Pierrehumbert
机构: University of Oxford(牛津大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (archival track)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Human children learn language from continuous, prosodically structured speech long before they can read, yet almost all language models train on orthographic text. Building on previous phonemic BabyLM training (Goriely et al., 2024; arXiv:2410.22906), we ask whether supplying an estimate of the prosody infants exploit improves phonemic language modelling at BabyLM scale. We compare an orthographic baseline to three conditions forming a ladder of phonological richness. All conditions are trained as BERT MLMs at 10M and 100M words. Addressing the ecological validity of existing metrics in the small-data regime, we build a lexical decision task and two semantic organisation tasks. Our new lexical decision task offers improved insights into the distinction between wordlikeness, token familiarity, and lexicality as factors. Triphone phonotactic control and pseudo-log-likelihood scoring shows that these scores reflect phonotactic familiarity rather than wordhood: every model sits near or below chance on an adversarial inverted condition, revealing prior results of this kind as partly artefactual. On our new semantic tasks, a prosodically annotated phoneme stream gives the strongest taxonomic organisation at both the 10M and 100M word scales. Phonemic models with boundary structure are competitive with the orthographic baseline. These findings suggest that prosodic structure is a key component of phonemic language modelling in the small-data regime most analogous to infant learning.

[NLP-241] Pronouncing Hard Words: Phoneme Adaptation of a Pretrained Conversational Text to Speech Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语音代理（generative voice agents）在医疗场景中对罕见且关键的药物名称发音控制不足的问题。现有基于端到端语音合成（text-to-speech, TTS）的对话式语音模型虽能实现自然流畅的语调适应，但因药物名称词汇量庞大、更新迅速且出现频率极低，难以通过常规预训练、中段训练或后训练阶段充分覆盖，导致其发音准确性差。为此，作者提出一种无需任何预训练或中段训练的解决方案：在已训练的对话式TTS模型基础上，引入ARPAbet音素词汇扩展，结合持续的音素增强型监督微调（phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning, SFT），并在推理阶段采用无训练的声学偏置（acoustic-biasing）策略，实现对特定词汇发音的显式控制。实验表明，在包含7500个临床药物发音片段的评估中，该方法将严格由Gemini模型判定的正确率从54.6%提升至90.7%，显著优于所有对话式及无状态基线模型；由于整个评估集完全为域外数据，未参与任何训练，性能提升反映的是模型对发音规则的泛化学习而非记忆。在盲测随机人类评估中，84%的生成音频被判定为正确，优于最强基线的82%，且置信区间重叠，验证了其实际可用性；同时，人工多数意见与Gemini判断的一致性达到84.8%（kappa=0.57），表明该方法在真实用户感知层面具备可靠性。核心创新在于不依赖训练即可实现对高风险专有词发音的精准控制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24164
作者: Yashish M. Siriwardena,Dinesh K. Gnanasekaran,Tanmay Laud,Shinji Watanabe,Subhabrata Mukherjee,Shanil Puri
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: 5 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Voice agents built as cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR)-large language model (LLM)- text-to-speech (TTS) pipelines increasingly rely on conversational TTS: streaming, context conditioned models that adapt delivery to dialogue history. Such models are natural and expressive but offer little explicit control over how rare, trust-critical drug names are pronounced, because these entities are too infrequent, and their vocabulary too fast-growing, to be covered by any amount of pre-, mid-, or post-training. We retrofit phoneme controllability onto a pretrained conversational TTS model without any pre/mid-training, using an ARPAbet vocabulary exten-sion, continued phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a training-free inference-time acoustic-biasing step. On a 7,500 clip clinical drug-pronunciation evaluation, our model raises strict Gemini-judged correctness from 54.6% (no phoneme augmentation) to 90.7%, outperforming every conversational and stateless TTS baseline on the automatic metric. Because no training stage sees a drug name, the entire evaluation is out-of-domain, so the gains reflect learned pronunciation rather than memorization. In a blinded, randomized human study, adult listeners judge 84% of our clips correct, versus 82% for the strongest baseline, with overlapping confidence intervals on a stratified subset. Across all 250 matched clips, Gemini agrees with the human majority on 84.8% of binary labels (kappa=0.57).

[NLP-242] CoDA: A Human-LM Collaborative Codebook Development Assistant for Domain-Specific Text Annotation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在缺乏高质量标注指南（codebook）的情况下，如何高效、准确地利用语言模型（LM）对非结构化文本进行领域特定信息提取的问题。现有语言模型标注系统普遍假设标注指南已存在且质量较高，但实际中构建此类指南耗时费力，尤其对于依赖专家知识的复杂概念而言更为困难。其解决方案的关键在于提出CoDA——一个开源的人机协同代码本开发助手，通过与领域专家协作，基于对语言模型错误预测的针对性审查，并将专家反馈动态融入代码本的迭代更新过程，从而实现高效生成高质量代码本。实验表明，CoDA在两个真实场景（流浪者管理记录中的健康指标提取与社交媒体上野生动物非法交易帖子的情感分类）中，生成的代码本可达到与人工专家制定的代码本相当的下游分类性能，同时将代码本开发时间从数周缩短至2小时，并减少5倍的手动标注样本需求。该方法显著提升了语言模型在大规模非结构化文本中提取领域洞察的能力。

作者: Jaspreet Ranjit,Swaminathan Chellappa,Augusto Rivas Costante,Chandan Manjunath,Laura Onasch-Vera,Hailey Winetrobe Nadel,Eric Rice,Swabha Swayamdipta

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:We present CoDA, an open-source human-LM collaborative codebook development assistant that helps domain experts develop annotation guidelines for annotating new variables in unstructured text with language models. Existing language model annotation systems primarily focus on downstream classification performance, while assuming the availability of high-quality annotation guidelines, or codebooks. In practice, developing these codebooks is time-consuming and challenging, particularly for concepts that require expert knowledge. CoDA addresses this gap by collaborating with domain experts to iteratively develop codebooks through targeted review of incorrect language model predictions and incorporating expert feedback into the evolving codebook. We demonstrate CoDA on two real-world case studies: extracting health indicators from homelessness case management notes and classifying sentiment of wildlife trafficking posts on social media. Across both domains, CoDA produces codebooks that achieve downstream classification performance comparable to expert codebooks while reducing codebook development time from several weeks to two hours and requiring 5X fewer manually annotated examples. Applying CoDA to generate annotations at scale, we identified 2,410 case notes that contained health discussions or referrals and 10,196 social media posts expressing negative sentiment that may warrant investigation for potential wildlife trafficking. By accelerating codebook development, CoDA helps practitioners use language models to extract domain-specific insights from unstructured text at scale.

[NLP-243] Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在开放式环境中进行持续学习时面临的无监督持续适应问题，尤其是现有测试时自适应方法因依赖单一策略生成的自我监督信号而导致的策略漂移、推理能力退化和灾难性遗忘。其核心挑战在于：当模型不断更新时，若自监督信号来自自身（即单个策略），则该信号会随策略漂移而失效，进而导致性能崩溃。为应对这一问题，论文提出进化策略强化学习（Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning, ESRL），其关键创新在于：将自生成监督信号的来源从单一策略扩展为一个由扰动锚点政策生成的策略群体。具体而言，ESRL通过在参数空间中对锚定策略进行扰动生成一组邻近策略，从中采样轨迹并聚合其输出作为无标签的相对学习信号，用于指导中心学生模型的更新。锚定策略在每个训练块内保持固定，并在块边界处由学生模型刷新，从而确保群体始终围绕一个稳定且当前的策略分布，持续提供多样化且可靠的监督信号。实验表明，该方法在数学推理、通用知识及医学领域等单任务测试时适应场景中，相较于基线模型平均准确率提升最高达31.7%，相比最强的测试时适应基线提升16.6%，显著缓解了灾难性遗忘，并实现了持续学习下的最优最终性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24137
作者: Guangya Hao,Yiting Duan,Longyan Tan,Yunbo Long,Hao Wu,Ge Zheng,Alexandra Brintrup,Zhuokai Zhao
机构: University of Cambridge(剑桥大学); Western Sydney University(西悉尼大学); The Alan Turing Institute(艾伦·图灵研究所); University of Chicago(芝加哥大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbfEvolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL), a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

[NLP-244] Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模序列化算法任务中因深度扩展或思维链（chain-of-thought）长度增加所带来的参数量和推理计算成本急剧上升的问题。现有方法如深层Transformer或长思维链虽能提升模型表现，但分别面临参数冗余与计算开销过高的挑战。为此，论文提出并研究了环状变压器（looped transformer），其通过重复使用单一层块实现有效深度的扩展，从而在不增加参数量或序列长度的前提下提升模型能力。研究的关键在于揭示环状结构的本质作用机制：通过设计有向排列遍历任务（directed permutation traversal），该任务每一步中间节点均有明确真值标签，可精确追踪模型在迭代过程中的状态演化。实验发现，仅当达到最小有效深度时，模型才能完成任务；而在此基础上，权重共享程度成为决定性能的关键因素——相同有效深度下，环状变压器在所有随机种子中均能成功解题，而等效的非共享（untied）模型则完全失败，除非采用更低的学习率或对中间层进行监督。通过对残差流的探针分析与干预，进一步揭示环状模型在迭代过程中逐步推进至各中间节点，形成适应迭代预算的“阶梯式”状态演化路径，而非共享模型仅在最终层才显现出中间状态。因此，研究结果将环状变压器重新诠释为迭代程序学习器，能够将有限的迭代次数合理分配给算法的各个步骤，从而解决同等有效深度下非共享模型无法处理的任务。

类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows H hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model advances through the intermediate nodes gradually, forming a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget, whereas the untied model, at that lower rate, exposes them only in its final layers. Taken together, our results recast looped transformers as iterative program learners, which allocate their iterations to successive steps of the algorithm and solve tasks that identically-trained untied models of the same effective depth do not. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-245] Prefix-Tuning for Arbitrary Output Sequences on Pretrained Transformers NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中前缀调优（Prefix-tuning）方法的理论可表达性问题，具体而言，其核心问题是：对于一个预训练的自回归Transformer模型，给定任意输入-输出序列对 (x,y)(x, y)(x,y)，是否存在一个任务特定的前缀 S\mathcal{S}S，使得将 S\mathcal{S}S 前缀拼接到输入 xxx 之前，能够确保模型生成目标输出 yyy？论文的关键解决方案在于证明：在目标输出 yyy 属于预训练Transformer模型输出空间这一假设下，这样的前缀 S\mathcal{S}S 不仅存在，且可通过求解多个线性系统进行显式构造。同时，论文进一步证明该假设是必要的——当该假设不成立时，前缀可能不存在，从而给出了该问题的完整理论解答。分析过程具有构造性，适用于较为通用的模型架构，并在GPT-2和Qwen3-4B上通过大量实验验证了所提出算法生成的前缀能有效控制模型输出，展现出强大的可控性。

作者: Peter Cho-Ho Lam,Ziyi Wang,Zirui Zhou
机构: Huawei Technologies Canada Co., Ltd.(华为技术加拿大有限公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL . Online demo: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Prefix-tuning is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models (LLMs) that steers model outputs by prepending task-specific prefix representations to the input sequence. Despite its practical success, the theoretical understanding of the expressiveness of prefixes remains incomplete. In particular, the following question remains open: Given a pretrained autoregressive Transformer, for any input-output sequence pair (\mathttx,\mathtty) , does there always exist a prefix \mathcalS such that prepending \mathcalS to \mathttx induces the model to generate the target output \mathtty ? In this work, we prove that under the assumption that \mathtty is in the range of the pretrained Transformer, such a prefix \mathcalS exists and can be explicitly computed by solving multiple linear systems. We further show that this assumption is necessary, in the sense that such a prefix may not exist when the assumption fails, thereby providing a complete answer to the above question. Our analysis is constructive and the obtained theoretical results hold under fairly general assumptions on model architecture. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 and Qwen3-4B demonstrate that our algorithm produces prefixes with strong control over model outputs.

[NLP-246] Do LMs Know What Variables Do? Interpreting Code Representations via Variable Roles

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）中可变角色（Variable Roles）语义表征的可恢复性、稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）对这些角色区分的保留能力，以及基于角色方向进行生成控制时的正确性保持问题。其核心挑战在于：如何在不破坏生成正确性的前提下，实现对代码中典型行为模式（如累积、遍历、最优候选保留等）的精准识别与可控干预。解决方案的关键在于构建一个涵盖11种角色的静态标注规则体系，并基于跨五种编程语言的126,926个自然代码文件构建基准数据集；通过残差探针（residual probes）评估角色表征的可恢复性，发现其性能优于单个SAE特征和词法基线，且在目标变量重命名后仍保持相对稳定；同时，整合多个SAE特征可显著缩小单特征性能差距，但对角色变更编辑的敏感性下降；尽管配对排序准确率较高，但在固定阈值下存在频繁误报；在生成阶段的干预虽常改变角色标注，但并未带来整体正确性提升，表明当前方法难以在保持生成正确性的同时实现有效的角色控制。该基准通过匹配预测、源码编辑与生成干预三类任务，系统分离了角色可恢复性、SAE保真度与正确性保持控制之间的关系。

Abstract:Variable roles describe recurring behaviors such as accumulation, traversal, and retaining the best candidate encountered. We use Sajaniemi’s independently defined taxonomy to study which role distinctions can be recovered from large language models, how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) retain those distinctions, and whether associated directions support control of generation. We introduce static annotation rules for all eleven roles and a corpus of 126,926 natural-code files across five languages. Across five model-SAE systems, residual probes outperform individual SAE features and tested lexical baselines, with modest losses after neutral target renaming. Combining SAE features closes much of the single-feature gap, but probes on SAE reconstructions are less sensitive to role-changing edits reviewed by LLMs. High paired ranking accuracy coexists with frequent false positives at fixed thresholds. During generation, interventions often change role annotations at the cost of correctness; changes accompanied by passing tests show no clear aggregate advantage over random controls. The benchmark separates role-related recoverability, SAE fidelity, and correctness-preserving control through matched prediction, source edits, and generation interventions.

[NLP-247] Joint Decoupled or Agent : When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态学习中不同融合范式在不同数据和任务条件下的性能优劣问题，具体探讨联合预训练（JOINT）、解耦预训练（DECOUPLED）与基于大语言模型（LLM）的指令驱动方法（AGENT）三种范式在多种场景下的适用性。其核心挑战在于：在缺乏先验知识的情况下，如何根据任务特性、标注预算及模态表现选择最优的多模态融合策略。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于诊断信息的两阶段级联选择框架，利用未参与训练的表征诊断（如几何结构、监督表示质量）与文本标签匹配度等指标，结合任务类型和预算元数据，提前预测并选择最优范式。实验表明，该方法在留一组外评估中成功选出胜出范式的比例达71.4%，显著优于仅依赖元数据路由的54.2%，且平均相对遗憾更低（0.028 vs 0.057）。研究揭示了范式偏好受监督预算、任务格式及单模态5-最近邻（5-NN）准确率的影响，证明目标任务诊断信息可有效指导范式选择，从而实现高效、自适应的多模态系统部署。

Abstract:Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman \rho=-0.67 ). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

[NLP-248] OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理能否在不依赖专家预先重构的前提下，直接从原始客户材料中生成具备专家水平的运筹学（Operations Research, OR）解决方案这一关键问题。现有OR基准多基于自包含描述或预设优化任务，未能真实反映将原始业务文档转化为专业可交付成果的复杂翻译过程。为此，研究提出OR-License——一个涵盖10个工业场景、共31个实例的端到端基准，源自实际付费运筹学项目（总价值368万美元），完整保留了原始需求、输入数据、交付格式及信息边界（经脱敏处理）。为系统评估信息获取能力，引入可控的客户端模拟器ORSim，其仅披露业务事实而不提供运筹学专业知识；通过隐藏式评估验证方案可行性，并与客户认可的原始专家解进行客观质量对比。引入“部署调整质量”（Deployment-Adjusted Quality, DAQ）指标，综合衡量各实例中相对于专家表现的质量，对不可行解赋值为零。实验表明，尽管多个前沿LLM在条件性目标质量上超越专家参考值，但无一达到其DAQ水平；最强的Claude Code主配置实现88.39%严格可行性，DAQuan为0.87，低于专家参考值1.0。分析揭示，信息获取不仅限于澄清阶段，更延伸至解的开发与验证，后期阶段的问题解决确认率更高。轨迹分析识别出建模与实施环节的失败模式，且任务均衡化后的研究链完成率在不同模型间仅为24%–45%。研究结果强调：构建可靠长周期智能代理需持续解决信息鸿沟、忠实进行问题形式化，并建立基于证据的自我改进机制。

Abstract:Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.

[NLP-249] World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模人工智能（AI）代理在复杂软件生态系统中协同工作时，如何实现高效、可扩展的推理阶段计算资源利用的问题。其核心挑战在于理解并优化多智能体协作机制，以提升整体系统性能，尤其是在面对长期开放性问题和大型项目时。解决方案的关键在于提出并构建了一个名为“Software World”（软件世界）的仿真框架，该框架能够模拟真实且相互依赖的Python包生态系统的多智能体共事过程。通过生成具有不同主题、规模和依赖结构的真实软件环境，该框架支持智能体在高阶目标驱动下自主发现任务并与其他智能体协作，同时可灵活调控通信方式、所有权分配与资源调度等协作要素。实验结果表明，随着推理阶段计算资源的增加，系统性能呈可扩展提升，最优模型使下游软件效率最高提升31%；然而也揭示了部分前沿模型存在过早终止探索、进展停滞的现象。研究释放了完整的仿真框架与运行轨迹数据，为未来智能体协作机制的研究提供了重要基础。

Abstract:As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents’ work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at this https URL.

[NLP-250] LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前文本生成图像（Text-to-Image, T2I）模型评估体系中对复杂语义理解能力衡量不足的问题，尤其针对属性绑定、数值推理、空间关系及常识推理等高级认知能力的评估存在局限。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于逻辑约束满足问题（Constraint-Satisfaction Problem, CSP）的新评估范式，构建了一个形式化的逻辑框架，明确定义了对象、属性、关系及其在生成图像中需满足的逻辑约束条件（涵盖从单对象-属性到涉及全称量词∀、存在量词∃、计数count及蕴含→等逻辑算子的多对象关系约束）。通过该框架，研究引入LogicVal评估方法，融合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理，实现对生成图像是否满足复杂逻辑约束的精准判定。实验表明，尽管最佳模型在单一对象-属性约束上表现优异（准确率达98%），但在多对象关系约束下性能急剧下降至53%，且在多重约束组合下的组合泛化能力显著退化（从84%降至20%），同时对不可满足约束的识别率仅23%。该研究揭示了现有T2I模型在复杂逻辑语义理解方面的系统性短板，并证明逻辑驱动的评估方法能有效刻画模型的真实能力边界，为未来模型设计与评测提供了可解释、可量化的基准。

作者: Savitha Sam Abraham,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ( \forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow ). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbfLogicVal, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

[NLP-251] Discuss More Comment Less: Boosting Automated Research via Multi-Perspective Collaborative Review

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自动化论文生成后，自动化审稿环节中存在的质量控制瓶颈问题。现有方法多依赖单一模型反馈或简单聚合机制，未能显式建模真实同行评审中专家的职责分工与集体讨论过程，导致缺乏有效的交叉质询和可靠的决策依据。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为RoundtableReview的审议式多智能体框架，将论文结构化为八个语义槽，并协调六名具备互补视角、检索来源与专业职责的学术与产业界评审者。通过独立评估、交叉质询、圆桌讨论、动态加权投票及主席综合等环节，该框架实现了基于证据且可追溯的反馈生成，在两个自动化研究基线上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了论文质量，并在自动与人工评估中均优于基线，同时减少了所需评论数量。

作者: Junkai Zhou,Jiajia Wu,Zhaoyi Zhang,Shiting Guan,Chuanguang Yang
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As automated research is increasingly adopted for writing papers, automated review has become a critical link between paper generation and quality control. However, existing methods largely rely on single-model feedback or simple review aggregation, failing to explicitly model expert responsibilities or collective deliberation in actual peer reviews, which limits effective cross-examination and reliable decision-making. Therefore, we formulate paper review as a computational modeling problem of peer review mechanisms and propose RoundtableReview, a deliberative multi-agent framework for enhancing automated research. RoundtableReview structures each paper into eight semantic slots and coordinates six academic and industry reviewers with complementary perspectives, retrieval sources, and specialized responsibilities. Through independent assessment, cross-examination, roundtable deliberation, dynamically weighted voting, and chair synthesis, the framework generates evidence-based and traceable feedback. Experiments on two automated research backbones show that the method improves paper quality in both backbones and outperforms baselines in automatic and human evaluations with fewer comments.

[NLP-252] he Window Is in the Reasoning : When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在处理不可信内容时，易受提示注入（prompt injection）攻击的问题，尤其关注现有评估方法和运行时监控机制所依赖的隐含假设——即智能体是否受注入影响在读取注入内容时即已确定。这一假设认为，决策结果在注入被读取的时刻便已固定。然而，本文通过分支回放（branching rollouts）方法对这一假设进行了检验：在智能体读取注入指令的节点处精确重放历史状态，并多次重新采样后续行为路径，从而将结果方差分解为“读取时刻即固定的成分”与“读取后动态决定的成分”。实验结果表明，在四个AgentDojo基准套件中，未启用思考（thinking）的Qwen3智能体有91%的结果方差在读取时刻即已确定；而启用思考后，该比例下降至62%（95%置信区间下降幅度为[-0.38, -0.22]），且在三种攻击模板和两种成功判定标准下均呈现一致趋势。这说明思考机制显著降低了注入攻击的确定性影响。进一步分析发现，读取时刻决定程度是模型固有的属性，且思考虽降低Qwen3的攻击成功率，却提升另外两个模型的攻击成功率。通过对推理前缀（reasoning prefix）的重采样显示，决策过程是逐步形成的。此外，基于低成本模型构建的零样本思维链（zero-shot chain-of-thought）监控器未能捕捉到大量已确定的决策信息，而更强大的监控器及具有前瞻判断能力的“前瞻监控器”（lookahead monitor）则能接近前缀所决定的最终结果。最后，研究指出，启用思考的智能体在单次运行与重跑之间的任务评分一致性仅达65%（即最多35%的不一致率），因此现有依赖单次运行的评估基准需采用重复运行以获得可靠性能指标。该研究的核心解决方案在于揭示了决策动态性，并提出应通过多轮回放、前缀分析与强化监控机制来更准确地识别和防范提示注入风险。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24048
作者: Haoxuan Jia,Yang Liu,Bin Chong,Yingguang Yang,Yancheng Chen,Jiayu Liang,Qian Li,Hanning Lu,Kefu Xu,Hao Zheng,Chongyang Zhang,Yulin Huang,Jianshen Zhang,Yongzhi Qi,Yunuo Lin,Hao Peng

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents that read untrusted content can be hijacked by prompt injections. Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read. We test this assumption with branching rollouts that replay an episode exactly up to the step at which the agent reads an injection and then resample the rest of the episode many times, splitting the outcome variance into a part fixed at read time and a part decided afterwards. Across four AgentDojo suites, a Qwen3 agent without thinking is largely decided at read time (0.91 of the outcome variance lies between states); with thinking on, this share drops to 0.62 (95% CI of the drop [-0.38, -0.22]), in the same direction for three attack templates and two success labels. How much is fixed at read time is a property of the model that the same measurement reveals, and thinking lowers the attack success rate of Qwen3 but raises it for two other models. Resampling from reasoning prefixes shows that the decision forms gradually as the agent reasons. Zero-shot chain-of-thought monitors built on cheaper models miss much of what is already decided, whereas stronger monitors, and a lookahead monitor that judges simulated next actions, come close to what the prefix determines. Finally, single-run labels of thinking agents disagree with a rerun up to 35% of the time, so benchmarks need repeated runs per task.

[NLP-253] LLM Evolutionary Search Strategies Should be Compared by Tokens

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）进化搜索评估中普遍采用“提案数量”（即候选程序数量）作为衡量标准所导致的误导性问题。研究表明，这一指标掩盖了实际计算成本，因为不同方法在生成相同数量提案时所消耗的令牌（tokens）差异巨大，范围从16k到39k不等。这种隐性差异使得某些方法在同等提案数下实际上获得了高达1.9倍的计算资源优势，而进化搜索相比独立采样甚至获得约6倍的预算优势。通过将评估基准统一为令牌预算，并在控制评分器利用（scorer exploits）的前提下进行对比，发现进化搜索的优势显著减弱：在15个任务-方法组合中，仅有3组保持23%至28%的性能优势，其余12组的差距不超过5%。进一步的复现实验使用Claude Haiku 4.5验证了该结果的可重复性，但同时也表明模型规模对性能表现具有显著影响。研究结论指出，现有系统所宣称的性能优势很大程度上源于评估方式的会计误差。因此，论文提出以“令牌消耗量”而非提案数量或模型调用次数作为核心评估指标，该方案无需额外开销，因日志数据已完整记录令牌使用情况，且能更真实反映计算成本与效率。

机构: IBM Research(IBM研究院)
类目: Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM evolutionary search is currently evaluated by counting proposals (candidate programs). We demonstrate this metric hides the true cost of search, and redo the comparison using tokens. By replaying 600 logged runs across 5 tasks and 3 methods, we show that proposal costs vary wildly from 16k to 39k tokens. In equal-proposal comparisons, this silently grants some methods up to 1.9x the compute of others, and gives evolution roughly 6x the budget of independent sampling. When we match token budgets, giving sampling six times more attempts, and remove scorer exploits, the evolutionary advantage largely vanishes. Evolution beats independent sampling by 5% or less on 12 of 15 task-method pairs, retaining a 23 to 28% margin on only 3, all on one task. A replication with Claude Haiku 4.5 reproduces this split, though a third backbone shows its size depends on the model too. The performance margin justifying these systems is often an accounting artifact. Reporting tokens, not proposals and not model calls, fixes this and costs nothing, as the logs already hold them.

[NLP-254] UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模语言模型（LLM）在代码生成能力提升过程中，因高质量公开代码数据日益稀缺而导致的训练数据瓶颈问题。随着传统通过扩大语料库规模推动模型性能提升的路径趋于饱和，研究提出采用分层数据管理（tiered data management）策略，对有限的数据资源进行更精细化、目标导向的处理。其核心解决方案在于构建一个四层级（L0–L3）的代码数据体系：L0保留原始仓库数据以支持可复现性；L1通过可扩展的过滤、归一化与近似去重处理，为广泛预训练提供标准化代码；L2利用语言自适应的相关性信号与质量约束，算法筛选出高相关性、高质量的代码文件，生成约4000亿词元的UltraData-Code-L2数据集，用于聚焦式持续预训练；L3则将选定实现转化为结构化的编程任务，产出约1500亿词元的UltraData-Code-L3数据集，适用于任务导向的中段训练或监督微调（SFT）。实验表明，在100亿词元的持续预训练下，相较于L1，L2在EvalPlus和MultiPL-E基准上分别提升7.80和5.13个百分点；若将一半L2数据替换为L3，进一步提升8.42和8.07个百分点，且随着训练预算扩大，增益更加显著。该方案的关键在于通过分层数据设计实现从原始数据到任务专用数据的高效转化，从而在有限数据条件下最大化模型训练效率与性能表现。

机构: Peking University (北京大学); ModelBest Inc.; Tsinghua University (清华大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.

[NLP-255] How Data Scales in Agent ic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式智能体（agentic AI）预训练中一个根本性问题：传统预训练数据规模定律将数据视为单一维度的词元数量（token count），而现代合成流水线可独立生成任务（task）、环境（environment）和轨迹（trajectory）三类结构化数据，且各类型生成成本差异显著。这使得预训练从未面临的核心问题浮现——在给定合成预算下，应优先扩展哪个数据维度？其解决方案的关键在于提出并验证一套多维数据规模定律（multi-axis scaling laws）。研究首次系统分解智能体数据为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴及奖励密度控制变量，基于数学+代码、SWE、网页、UI/工具应用等多个领域的大语言模型（LLM）实证分析发现，不同模型规模、架构、算法（PPO与GRPO）下，各轴的缩放指数均呈现统一排序：环境 > 任务 > 轨迹。进一步分析表明，环境多样性优势主要源于世界多样性（world diversity），而环境结构多样性仅相当于任务多样性的水平。在此基础上，研究利用拟合出的缩放规律作为统一标尺，量化各类合成方法的效率（以每轴折扣因子表示），识别出导致性能塌陷的临界合成-真实比值，该比值在不同轴间相差一个数量级。最终，将预算分配建模为受缩放定律与效率折扣约束的优化问题，推导出类似Chinchilla的计算最优配置方案，并在未参与训练的规模上验证，结果表明遵循该方案可实现相较于主流“扩大轨迹”策略高达1.7倍的计算效率提升。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23946
作者: Bowei He,Yankai Chen,Xiaokun Zhang,Changjiang Han,Ye Yuan,Chong Li,Xue Liu
机构: MBZUAI; McGill University; CityUHK; Columbia University
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textittasks, \textitenvironments, and \textittrajectories independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textitwhich axis should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment task trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method’s efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to 1.7\times compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories’’ practice.

[NLP-256] Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长期个性化智能体在跨模态、跨会话场景下对分布式历史信息进行推理时面临的挑战，特别是现有扁平化跨模态方法因过早压缩视觉证据而导致时间滞后的观察失效，且无法有效统一多模态与跨会话证据。其核心问题在于原始多模态记忆具有固有的纠缠性与异质性，导致细粒度视觉定位与跨模态推理计算开销巨大。为应对这一问题，论文提出一种新型神经符号框架——潜在多模态记忆推理（Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning, LMMR），其关键创新在于将长期多模态记忆组织映射至连续潜在空间：首先，LMMR不依赖于图像到文本的静态转换与检索，而是将文本隐藏状态与视觉补丁特征共同嵌入共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间，通过稀疏激活作为通用语义地址，动态构建逐轮的多模态记忆图；其次，图编码器聚合任务相关的跨模态与时间依赖关系，并将图读出作为连续残差滚动注入生成主干网络，同时保留原始视觉标记以维持细粒度细节。实验在九个Mem-Gallery任务和十二个MemEye设置上验证了LMMR在捕捉复杂多模态依赖关系方面的显著优势，实现了更忠实、具象化的响应生成。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23890
作者: Cai Ke,Xinghao Chen,Yuanchen Bei,Yuni Lai,Keyu Chen,Ruizhi Qiao,Siyu An,Junnan Dong,Ruifeng Xu,Xing Sun
机构: Tencent Youtu Lab; Eastern Institute of Technology; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign; Xidian University; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-term personalized agents are required to reason over distributed history across modalities and evolving dialogue states. While existing flat cross-modal methods compress visual evidence prematurely and struggle with temporally stale observations, they neglect the necessity to unify multimodal and cross-session evidence. Crucially, raw multimodal memories are inherently entangled and heterogeneous, making fine-grained visual grounding and cross-modal reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present latent multimodal memory reasoning, i.e., LMMR, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term multimodal memory organization into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of converting images to text and relying on static retrieval, LMMR maps both textual hidden states and visual patch features into a shared Sparse Autoencoder concept space, establishing sparse activations as common semantic addresses to dynamically construct a turn-level multimodal memory graph. (ii) A graph encoder then aggregates cross-modal and temporal dependencies across the task-specific latent subgraph, injecting the graph readout as a continuous residual rollout into the generation backbone while retaining native visual tokens to preserve fine-grained details. Extensive experiments on nine Mem-Gallery tasks and twelve MemEye settings demonstrate that LMMR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing complex multimodal dependencies while enabling faithful and grounded responses.

[NLP-257] ranslating in style: An open-weight alternative to GPT -4 for culturally aligned machine translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决机器翻译系统在跨语言转换过程中普遍存在但被忽视的风格扁平化问题，尤其是在翻译至非西方语言时，译文往往丢失原文的语体特征（如正式度、礼貌性与亲密感）。现有解决方案RASTA框架（Havaldar et al., 2025a）虽通过检索增强的风格对齐有效提升了风格保真度，但其依赖闭源专有模型GPT-4，限制了可复现性与开放应用。本文的关键在于探索是否可使用开源权重的专用翻译模型Hunyuan-MT-7B替代GPT-4，构建一个开放可访问的风格对齐翻译流程。研究对比了该模型的三个变体：基础模型、基于监督微调的LoRA适配器以及采用GRPO策略优化的策略模型，在三个风格维度（正式度、礼貌性、亲密性）和十二个方向的语言对上进行评估，采用相关性指标A\mathcal{A}A衡量风格对齐效果。结果表明，微调并未显著提升整体风格对齐性能，三者在统计上无显著差异；尽管开源基线整体表现不及RASTA-GPT-4，但在正式度方面存在差距，但在亲密性及中文相关方向上，其性能已达到甚至超过GPT-4，尤其在个别语言对上表现优异。因此，基于开源模型的可访问式RASTA流程已在部分场景下具备可行性，标志着开放风格对齐翻译系统迈向实用的重要一步。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23868
作者: Thomas Rietman,Hadi Mohammadi,Robert A. Bagheri
机构: Utrecht University (乌得勒支大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 Pages excl references, 5 tables, 1 Figure

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Machine translation systems often preserve meaning but systematically flatten linguistic style, a failure that is most acute when translating into non-Western languages. The RASTA framework of Havaldar et al. (2025a) addresses this through retrieval-augmented stylistic alignment, but relies on GPT-4, a closed, proprietary model. We investigate whether an open-weight translation specialist, Hunyuan-MT-7B, can serve as an open-weight alternative. We evaluate three variants of the model, the base model, a LoRA supervised fine-tune, and a GRPO-steered policy. We do this across three style dimensions (formality, politeness, and intimacy) and twelve directed language pairs, measuring style alignment with the correlation-based metric \mathcalA . We find that fine-tuning does not reliably improve alignment: the three variants are statistically indistinguishable in aggregate. The open backbone does not match RASTA-GPT-4 overall, but the shortfall is concentrated in formality and largely closes for intimacy and Chinese directions, where the open model matches or surpasses GPT-4 on individual pairs. An accessible RASTA pipeline built on an open model is thus already viable for parts of the problem.

[NLP-258] Composable Parametric Demographic Injection for Values Survey Simulation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在计算社会科学中作为模拟受访者时，难以准确再现特定人群异质性响应分布的问题。现有方法如基于人口统计学的提示（demographic prompting）对提示设计敏感且增加推理开销，而基于参数的方法则难以高效复用人口统计学信息，导致对未见组合的泛化能力受限。针对上述挑战，论文提出PARADE——一种可组合的参数化人口统计学注入框架，其核心在于将每个人口统计属性值表示为可复用、可组合的低秩适配器（LoRA）模块。通过分离任务通用的调查能力与人口统计学特异性偏移，PARADE采用共享任务LoRA和属性级人口统计学LoRAs，并引入组合校准机制以减少参数干扰。在推理阶段，可通过重新组合相关模块动态构建目标人群模型，支持训练中未见过的人口统计组合。在世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）和SocioBench数据集上，基于三种主干模型的实验表明，PARADE在保持良好预测性能的同时，显著提升了群体层面的分布对齐效果，相较最强基线最高降低52.8%的KL散度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23867
作者: Xinyuan Cao,Qingyi Pan,Bangde Du,Yujia Zhou,Hexi Wang,Weihang Su,Yiqun Liu,Yueyue Wu,Min Zhang,Qingyao Ai
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as simulated respondents in computational social science, yet accurately reproducing population-specific heterogeneous response distributions remains challenging. Existing methods such as demographic prompting are sensitive to prompt design and increase inference overhead, while parameter-based methods struggle to reuse demographic information efficiently, limiting generalization to unseen combinations. In this regard, we propose PARADE, a composable PARAmetric DEmographic injection framework that represents each demographic attribute value with a reusable and composable LoRA module. Specifically, PARADE separates task-common survey capability from demographic-specific value shifts via a shared Task LoRA and attribute-level Demographic LoRAs, with composition calibration to reduce parameter interference. At inference time, target population models can be constructed on demand by recombining the relevant modules, including demographic combinations not observed during training. Extensive experiments on the World Values Survey and SocioBench across three backbone models show that PARADE achieves strong population-level distribution alignment while maintaining competitive predictive performance, reducing KL divergence by up to 52.8% relative to the strongest baseline.

[NLP-259] GardenBench: A lightweight daily evaluation of LLM capabilities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）评估基准在动态性能监测与实际应用场景覆盖方面的不足，特别是对模型每日性能波动、推理成本与响应时间等关键指标的忽视。传统基准多聚焦于静态任务评估，难以捕捉模型在真实使用中随时间演变的准确率变化、性能退化或更新带来的影响。为此，论文提出GardenBench，一个包含11个测试套件的轻量级、低成本评估基准，通过系统性地向LLMs注入多样化轻量查询，持续监控其在日常任务中的表现，涵盖准确性、响应时间与运行成本等维度。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个面向消费者、可实时更新的动态评估框架，结合公开可访问的在线仪表盘，实现对不同模型提供商及版本在真实使用场景下的横向对比，从而更全面地反映模型的实际能力演进，推动评估方法从静态向动态、从封闭向开放转变。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23866
作者: Benedict Cummins-Mburu,Mariana Garcia Mejia,Oscar Heath,Sabrina Kreyzerman,Ellie Murray,Arusan Surendiran,Rohan Alexander
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss. This allows us to compare the accuracy and features of responses across model providers and versions. We account for daily variations in model accuracy, capturing both model progress and degradation, for instance, when a model is changed post-deployment or when a new model is released. We base our evaluation on general-use tasks and make our results publicly accessible via a live dashboard, diversifying existing approaches to LLM testing. Our main contribution is an innovative, lightweight, and inexpensive benchmark, designed to be consumer-facing and for everyday tasks.

[NLP-260] Modeling Human Behavior in the Prisoners Dilemma with Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在重复囚徒困境博弈中能否有效模拟人类合作行为的问题，尤其关注开源大语言模型（LLM）在具备记忆能力与面对对手随机轮换情境下的决策表现。其核心挑战在于现有研究普遍缺乏对模型记忆机制的支持、可复现的开源模型对比以及与真实人类实验数据的直接验证。解决方案的关键在于构建一个标准化的提示框架，系统评估五种开源大模型（TII Falcon 7B Instruct、Google Gemma 7B、Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct）在两种典型交互环境中的表现：固定搭档（双方均具记忆）与随机轮换搭档（记忆型模型面对无记忆对手）。研究通过100轮博弈中每10轮的协作率变化进行量化分析，并与蒙特罗-波拉斯等人（2022）的人类实证数据进行对比。结果表明，所有模型均显著偏离人类协作水平，普遍表现出过度合作现象，尤其在随机轮换情境下，人类平均协作率为28.5%，而多个模型协作率超过80%；其中Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct呈现确定性行为模式，而Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct则展现出更高变异性并短暂逼近人类水平。这表明尽管开源大模型具备作为行为模拟代理的潜力，但在模拟真实人类社会互动方面仍存在显著偏差，尚未能可靠替代人类参与者。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23860
作者: Raina Gao,Tristan Raffo
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The Prisoner’s Dilemma has long served as a foundational framework for studying human decision-making and cooperative outcomes across social scenarios, yet human behavior consistently deviates from predictions of fully rational economic theory. Previous works have studied human and LLM outcomes in the Prisoner’s Dilemma; however, these studies have lacked at least one key feature: a memory component for LLM agents, accessible open-source models, or comparison against empirical human data. This project investigates whether open-source LLMs, TII Falcon 7B Instruct, Google Gemma 7B, Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct, and Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, can model human cooperation patterns in repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma games, while examining how an LLM’s knowledge that its opponent will be shuffled affects its decisions. Using a standardized prompting framework, we simulated interactions in two trial types: a fixed-partner setting where both agents retain memory, and a shuffled-partner setting where a memory-enabled agent, informed that its opponent changes across rounds, interacts with a memoryless agent. For each trial, we measured cooperation rates over 100 rounds and 10-round increments and compared them to human data from Montero-Porras et al. (2022). Under both frameworks, all LLMs differed from the human cooperation rate. Open-source LLMs generally over-cooperated relative to humans, particularly in the shuffled framework, where human cooperation averaged 28.5% while several models exceeded 80%. Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct showed deterministic tendencies, while Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct displayed greater variability and briefly approximated human rates. These findings suggest that LLMs have potential as behavioral simulation agents and provide a benchmark across two interaction environments, although open-source models are not yet reliable substitutes for human participants.

[NLP-261] I2-Med: Interpretable Medical Inference through Visual-Guided Dynamic Logits Calibration

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医学视觉语言模型在医学图像理解与推理任务中面临的可解释性与可靠性不足问题，核心挑战在于实现精确的视觉定位（visual grounding）和临床一致性的解释生成，而这一目标因复杂的影像学模式及稀缺的专业标注数据而难以达成。传统推理方法在此背景下易产生视觉幻觉（visual hallucination），即生成内容脱离图像实际信息，严重制约其在临床实践中的应用。本文提出的可解释医学推理框架I²-Med，其关键创新在于无需额外训练即可增强推理过程中的视觉忠实性：在文本生成阶段，引入一个视觉引导模块，实时评估候选词汇是否被医学图像支持并符合当前推理逻辑，据此动态调整输出分数，优先选择与图像一致的语义项，从而提升生成内容的视觉可信度与临床合理性。实验基于OmniMedVQA基准，在八种医学成像模态与五类临床问题上验证了该框架的有效性，显著提升了推理链的临床意义与视觉一致性，同时减少了视觉幻觉现象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23858
作者: Md Sajid,Shreeyut Maheshwari,Akshat Mishra,Ritik Mishra,Mohammad Tanveer
机构: 未知
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Medical vision language models have demonstrated strong potential for medical image understanding and reasoning. However, their interpretability and reliability remain limited because medical vision language tasks require precise visual grounding and clinically coherent explanations. This is particularly challenging due to complex imaging patterns and scarce expert annotations. These challenges reduce the effectiveness of conventional reasoning methods and lead to visual hallucination, defined as the generation of text that is not grounded in the given visual input, which further limits their applicability in clinical practice. To mitigate these challenges, we propose an interpretable medical inference (I ^2 -Med) framework that enhances visual faithfulness during inference without additional training to improve reasoning and explanation faithfulness in medical vision language models. During text generation, I ^2 -Med uses a visual guidance module to check whether each candidate word is supported by the medical image and consistent with the current reasoning. Based on this guidance, the model’s output scores are adjusted to favor visually grounded words, without changing the model parameters. Extensive experiments on the OmniMedVQA benchmark, covering eight medical imaging modalities and five clinical question types, demonstrate that our proposed I ^2 -Med framework generates more clinically meaningful and visually faithful reasoning chains and reduces visual hallucination under standard medical VQA evaluation metrics. The source code is publicly available at \urlthis https URL.

[NLP-262] ransformer-based segmentation of prosodic boundaries in Brazilian Portuguese

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决巴西葡萄牙语（Brazilian Portuguese, BP）中自动韵律切分（automatic prosodic segmentation）性能不足的问题，现有方法仍主要依赖规则或传统机器学习，难以充分捕捉复杂语言特征。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于Whisper large-v3的端到端切分模型SAMPA，通过在人工标注的NURC-SP数据集上微调，并在语音转录过程中显式插入韵律边界标记，实现对韵律边界的精准识别。实验表明，SAMPA在不同训练与测试配置下均表现出色，尤其在保留测试集上达到F1=0.731，而在跨数据集的分布外测试（MuPe-Diversidades）中更取得F1=0.796，显著优于以往方法。进一步的n-gram及声学-视觉分析揭示，模型能够有效利用形态句法、语义和韵律线索进行边界检测，验证了其对语言结构的深层理解能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07408
作者: Rodrigo de Freitas Lima,Julio Cesar Galdino,Marcos Vinicius Treviso
机构: University of São Paulo (圣保罗大学); Instituto Superior Técnico (里斯本高等技术学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 6 pages, 5 figures, submitted to an IEEE conference

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automatic prosodic segmentation identifies boundaries between speech units from acoustic and linguistic evidence. Although recent deep learning approaches have produced strong results for English, automatic segmentation for Brazilian Portuguese (BP) still relies mostly on rule-based or traditional machine-learning methods. This paper presents SAMPA, a Whisper-based segmenter that transcribes BP speech while inserting explicit markers for terminal prosodic boundaries. We fine-tune Whisper large-v3 on manually segmented recordings from the NURC-SP dataset and evaluate different training and test-time filtering configurations, including out-of-distribution testing on the MuPe-Diversidades dataset. SAMPA achieves competitive boundary-detection performance across settings, with the best models reaching F1=0.731 on the held-out test split and F1=0.796 on MuPe-Diversidades. Finally, through n-gram and acoustic-visual analyses, we show that our model follows morphosyntactic, semantic, and prosodic cues for detecting prosodic boundaries.

[NLP-263] ransfer Learning for Power Outage Detection Task with Limited Training Data

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决电力系统中停电事件早期检测的难题，尤其针对标注数据有限场景下的模型性能瓶颈。其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏大量人工标注样本的情况下，实现对停电事件的高效、准确识别。解决方案的关键在于利用预训练语言模型（Language Models）结合迁移学习（transfer learning）与少样本学习（few-shot learning）策略，通过在大规模通用语料上预训练模型，并在少量标注的社交媒体文本数据上进行微调，从而有效提升模型在未见类别上的泛化能力。实验结果表明，尽管零样本学习表现逊于传统模型，但经过少量数据微调后，BERT和GPT等模型的准确率显著提升，分别达到81.3%和74.5%，验证了少样本微调在资源受限条件下的有效性。这一方法为基于自然语言处理技术的基础设施监控提供了可行路径，尤其适用于实时性要求高且标注成本昂贵的应用场景。

作者: Olukunle Owolabi
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Applications (stat.AP)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Early detection of power outages is crucial for maintaining a reliable power distribution system. This research investigates the use of transfer learning and language models in detecting outages with limited labeled data. By leveraging pretraining and transfer learning, models can generalize to unseen classes. Using a curated balanced dataset of social media tweets related to power outages, we conducted experiments using zero-shot and few-shot learning. Our hypothesis is that Language Models pretrained with limited data could achieve high performance in outage detection tasks over baseline models. Results show that while classical models outperform zero-shot Language Models, few-shot fine-tuning significantly improves their performance. For example, with 10% fine-tuning, BERT achieves 81.3% accuracy (+15.3%), and GPT achieves 74.5% accuracy (+8.5%). This has practical implications for analyzing and localizing outages in scenarios with limited data availability. Our evaluation provides insights into the potential of few-shot fine-tuning with Language Models for power outage detection, highlighting their strengths and limitations. This research contributes to the knowledge base of leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques for managing critical infrastructure. [NLP-264] acher Supervision Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中候选答案评分模型在知识迁移过程中因教师模型偏差、固定表征与概率校准不当所导致的决策风险问题。其核心挑战在于：即使采用大规模教师模型生成软标签（soft targets）、冻结预训练主干网络（frozen pretrained backbone）以及温度校准（temperature calibration）等常见训练策略，学生模型仍可能继承教师模型的系统性偏差，且这些偏差无法通过增加数据量或与教师的一致性来识别或消除。解决方案的关键在于：首先，明确指出在高斯代理模型中，固定表征仅在样本量超过特定阈值时才能降低风险；其次，证明在probit模型下，精确的概率校准映射为温度缩放，但该方法仅当教师系数方向正确时才能完全消除过量风险，否则会残留不可被诊断工具检测的偏差；再次，基于Luce选择公理，提出候选得分在事件细化下保持一致性的充要条件是其聚合方式必须为log-sum-exp形式，从而定义了概率一致性（coherence）的标准。实证分析显示，在231,521条消费者金融保护局信用卡投诉数据上，以教师概率为监督信号的学生模型维持了教师的决策成本，而以真实结果为监督信号的学生模型则实现8%的成本下降；即使使用300亿参数的零样本模型，其校准后性能仍劣于教师模型，且其违反一致性条件的程度高达17.5德比安（decibans）。因此，尽管预训练表征可减少标注数据需求，校准能修正概率尺度，但二者均无法纠正有偏教师带来的系统性误差，故必须将模型输出的概率与实际发生结果进行验证，以确保决策可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26797
作者: Agus Sudjianto,Denis Burakov
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (stat.ML); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Risk Management (q-fin.RM)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code in ancillary files

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher’s bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher’s coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce’s choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher’s probabilities ends at the teacher’s decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.

[NLP-265] Dual Task Vector Merging: Leverag ing Emotion and ASR Knowledge for Low-Resource Alzheimers Disease Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’s Disease, AD）语音检测中因数据稀缺导致的模型过拟合与预训练语音编码器知识利用不充分的问题。现有方法中，全量微调易引发过拟合，而固定编码器的探针（frozen probe）则无法有效利用编码器中与任务相关的信息。为此，本文提出双任务向量融合（Dual Task Vector Merging）这一参数高效的方法，通过从情感识别和自动语音识别（ASR）任务微调得到的wav2vec 2.0模型中提取权重增量（weight deltas），将两个任务向量注入到每个Transformer层中，仅在AD任务训练时优化层间融合系数与线性分类头，整体更新参数不足全微调的0.1%。实验表明，在独立说话人设置下，该方法在ADReSS和ADReSSo数据集上优于冻结探针、LoRA及全微调，在二分类任务中表现最优；结合LoRA后进一步提升性能；在PROCESS数据集上，其优势可迁移至三分类（健康对照/轻度认知障碍/痴呆）任务。在低资源场景（20%、40%、80%训练数据）下的实验也验证了该方法在数据受限条件下的稳健性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24870
作者: Yuan-Chao Li,Yin-Long Liu,Liu He,Sizhe Liu,Ji-Xuan Deng,Yin Zhang,Zhen-Hua Ling,Jiahong Yuan
机构: 未知
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) detection from speech benefits from both paralinguistic and linguistic cues, yet model training is frequently constrained by limited data. Fine-tuning a large pretrained speech encoder can easily overfit, while a frozen probe leaves the encoder’s task-relevant knowledge underutilized. Therefore, we propose Dual Task Vector Merging, a parameter-efficient method that adapts a frozen wav2vec 2.0 backbone using task knowledge learned outside the AD task. Specifically, we inject two task vectors, derived as weight deltas from emotion- and ASR-fine-tuned wav2vec 2.0 models, into each transformer layer. During AD training, only layer-wise merging coefficients and a linear classification head are optimized, updating less than 0.1% of the parameters required for full fine-tuning. Speaker-independent experiments on ADReSS and ADReSSo show that dual merging improves over frozen probes, LoRA, and full fine-tuning, in the main binary settings, and gives the best results when combined with LoRA. Evaluation on PROCESS further shows that our advantages transfer to three-class HC/MCI/dementia classification when paired with LoRA. Experiments under reduced training data (20%, 40%, and 80%) confirm reliable gains in low-resource settings.

[IR-0] AGR: Agent ic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26831
作者: Ming Yang,Yaqi Yin,Zhibo Wang,Xiaoze Jiang,Jingwei Zhuo,Chao Zhang,Quanzhi Zhu,Weiguo Zheng,Liang Zeng,Yunfeng Zhao,Jiaqiang Liu,Kefeng Wang,Yupeng Huang,Kaiqiao Zhan,Xuanping Li
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.

[IR-1] Next Best Action: Causal Constrained Offline RL for Business Action Targeting RECSYS2026

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26817
作者: Surya Ramachandiran,Yiming Li,Juan Mancilla-Caceres,Tao Ye,Jun Liu
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: Accepted for oral presentation at the ACM RecSys 2026 Workshop on Online and Adaptive Recommender System (OARS)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Next Best Action (NBA) systems must select among customer interventions (e.g., discounts, promotions, and lifecycle actions), maximize long-term economic value, satisfy complex operational constraints, and remain causally grounded. Existing approaches lack a rigorous framework for meeting these requirements jointly. We address this gap by formulating NBA as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP). We then integrate off-policy causal correction of the estimated customer dynamics directly into the Linear Programming (LP) formulation of the CMDP. The resulting policy selects actions based on customer states to maximize long-term value while explicitly enforcing business guardrails. Furthermore, the LP formulation yields shadow prices that quantify the economic trade-offs of operational constraints (e.g., fairness and user welfare), enhancing policy interpretability. We validate our proposed offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework on an industry case study involving rideshare coupon targeting, where customer states are defined by Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) stages. We evaluate performance using model-based off-policy evaluation, with causal dynamics estimated from a temporal holdout. Under the observed coupon budget and RFM state representation, our optimized policy improves customer lifetime value (LTV) by 19% over the estimated behavior policy and 8% over a myopic baseline. Although the demonstrated action space is binary, the proposed framework is action-agnostic, yielding a general-purpose decision module for targeting systems that manage multiple interventions.

[IR-2] Beyond Behavioral Accuracy: Evaluating Individual-Level Fidelity in LLM Investor Simulation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26524
作者: Jiajie He,Yuanhong Jiang,Xintong Chen,Dongling Ni,Wenjin Liu
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: This paper is under review in ARR

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, but can they faithfully reproduce an individual’s behavior and decision logic over time? We investigate this question in a longitudinal paper-trading study with 80 participants. Using rolling next-day predictions, we evaluate trading activity, buy-sell structure, asset selection, and portfolio outcomes, complemented by controlled input ablations and participant-rated explanation alignment. No evaluated LLM reliably outperforms a simple recent-activity persistence baseline for predicting trade occurrence, while buy-sell structure and asset selection remain difficult to reproduce. Similar activity-level performance can also yield substantially different portfolio trajectories. Ablations show that activity predictions depend primarily on recent trades, whereas asset choices are sensitive to multiple evidence sources. Participants rate explanations as more aligned with their recurring strategies than with their decision-specific rationales. These findings reveal a gap between coarse behavioral agreement and individual-level fidelity, motivating separate evaluation of behavioral accuracy, explanation alignment, and evidence dependence in personalized user simulation.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.
